title.zh: 卷三百二十九 列傳第二百十七 西域一
title.raw: 卷三百二十九 列傳第二百十七 西域一 Volume 329 Biographies 217: Western Regions 1

sentences.zh: 西域一 哈密卫 柳城 火州 土鲁番

translations.literal: Western Regions 1: Hami Guard, Liucheng, Huozhou, Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: Western Regions, Part One: Hami Guard, Liucheng, Huozhou, and Turpan.

sentences.zh: 哈密卫

translations.literal: Hami Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Hami Guard.

sentences.zh: 哈密，东去嘉峪关一千六百里，汉伊吾卢地。

translations.literal: Hami is one thousand six hundred li east of Jiayu Pass; it is the Han territory of Yiwulu.
translations.idiomatic: Hami lies sixteen hundred li east of Jiayu Pass, on the site of the Han-era land of Yiwulu.

sentences.zh: 明帝置宜禾都尉，领屯田。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming established the Yihé Commandant and put him in charge of military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of the Han set up the Yihé Commandant to oversee military farming colonies there.

sentences.zh: 唐为伊州。

translations.literal: Under the Tang it was Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang dynasty it was known as Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 宋入于回纥。

translations.literal: Under the Song it passed into the hands of the Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song period it fell under Uyghur control.

sentences.zh: 元末以威武王纳忽里镇之，寻改为肃王，卒，弟安克帖木儿嗣。

translations.literal: At the end of the Yuan, the Prince of Weiwu, Naqhuli, was stationed there to guard it; soon the title was changed to Prince of Su. When he died, his younger brother Anketiemuer succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuan dynasty the Prince of Weiwu, Naqhuli, was posted there as governor; the title was soon changed to Prince of Su. When he died, his younger brother Anketiemuer succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，太祖既定畏兀儿地，置安定等卫，渐逼哈密。

translations.literal: During the Hongwu reign, after the Taizu had secured the Uyghur lands, he established guards such as Anding, gradually pressing toward Hami.
translations.idiomatic: During the Hongwu reign, after the founding emperor had pacified the Uyghur territories and established guards such as Anding, Ming power gradually closed in on Hami.

sentences.zh: 安克帖木儿惧，将纳款。

translations.literal: Anketiemuer was afraid and was about to submit allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Anketiemuer grew fearful and prepared to submit to the Ming court.

sentences.zh: 成祖初，遣官招谕之，许其以马市易，即遣使来朝，贡马百九十匹。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yongle reign, the Chengzu sent officials to summon and instruct him, permitting him to trade horses at market; he immediately sent envoys to court and presented one hundred ninety horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongle reign, the Chengzu sent officials to summon him and promised that he might trade horses at market. He at once dispatched envoys to court and presented one hundred ninety horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 永乐元年十一月至京，帝喜，赐赉有加，命有司给直收其马四千七百四十匹，择良者十匹入内厩，余以给守边骑士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Yongle they reached the capital. The emperor was pleased and added extra gifts; he ordered the relevant offices to pay fair value and receive four thousand seven hundred forty of their horses, selecting ten fine ones for the inner stables and assigning the rest to border-guarding cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: They reached the capital in the eleventh month of Yongle 1. The emperor was delighted and lavished additional rewards upon them. He ordered the appropriate offices to pay fair price and take in four thousand seven hundred forty horses, selecting ten of the best for the imperial stables and distributing the rest to frontier cavalry.

sentences.zh: 明年六月复贡，请封，乃封为忠顺王，赐金印，复贡马谢恩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the following year they again presented tribute and requested enfeoffment; he was then enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Obedience and granted a gold seal, and again presented horses in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the following year they sent tribute again and requested formal enfeoffment. He was then created King of Loyalty and Obedience and given a gold seal, and sent horses once more in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 已而迤北可汗鬼力赤毒死之，其国人以病卒闻。

translations.literal: Before long the northern khan Guilichi poisoned him to death, and his people reported that he had died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Not long afterward the northern khan Guilichi poisoned him to death, while his people reported that he had died of natural causes.

sentences.zh: 三年二月遣官赐祭，以其兄子脱脱为王，赐玉带。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year officials were sent to grant sacrificial offerings, and his elder brother's son Tuo Tuo was made king and given a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongle 3 the court sent officials to perform sacrificial rites, installed his elder brother's son Tuo Tuo as king, and granted him a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 脱脱自幼俘入中国，帝拔之奴隶中，俾列宿卫，欲令嗣爵。

translations.literal: Tuo Tuo had been taken captive into China since childhood; the emperor raised him out of slavery, made him serve in the palace guard, and wished him to inherit the title.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Tuo had been taken captive into China as a child. The emperor plucked him from slavery, placed him in the palace guard, and intended him to inherit the kingship.

sentences.zh: 恐其国不从，遣官问之，不敢违，请还主其众。

translations.literal: Fearing that his country would not obey, the emperor sent officials to inquire; they did not dare refuse and requested that he return to rule his people.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing that Hami would not accept the arrangement, the emperor sent officials to consult them. They dared not refuse and asked that Tuo Tuo be sent back to lead their people.

sentences.zh: 因赐其祖母及母彩币，旋遣使贡马谢恩。

translations.literal: Thereupon silks and brocades were granted to his grandmother and mother, and envoys were soon sent to present horses in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The court then granted silks and brocades to his grandmother and mother, and Hami soon sent envoys with horses to express their gratitude.

sentences.zh: 四年春，甘肃总兵官宋晟奏，脱脱为祖母所逐。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, Song Sheng, commander-in-chief of Gansu, memorialized that Tuo Tuo had been driven out by his grandmother.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Yongle 4, Song Sheng, the overall military commander of Gansu, reported that Tuo Tuo had been expelled by his grandmother.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，敕责其头目曰：“脱脱朝廷所立，即有过，不奏而擅逐之，是慢朝廷也。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and issued an edict rebuking their chieftains, saying: 'Tuo Tuo was installed by the court. Even if he had faults, to drive him out without memorializing is to show contempt for the court.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged and issued an edict rebuking the chieftains: "Tuo Tuo was installed by the court. Even if he had faults, to expel him without reporting to us shows contempt for the throne."

sentences.zh: 老人昏耄，头目亦不知朝廷耶？

translations.literal: The old woman is senile—do the chieftains also not know the court?
translations.idiomatic: The old woman may be senile, but do you chieftains also fail to recognize the authority of the court?

sentences.zh: 即迎归，善匡辅，俾孝事祖母。”

translations.literal: Welcome him back at once, assist him well, and make him serve his grandmother filially.
translations.idiomatic: Bring him back immediately, guide him properly, and see that he fulfills his filial duty to his grandmother.

sentences.zh: 由是脱脱得还，祖母及头目各遣使谢罪。

translations.literal: Thereby Tuo Tuo was able to return, and the grandmother and chieftains each sent envoys to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Tuo was thus restored, and both the grandmother and the chieftains sent envoys to apologize.

sentences.zh: 三月立哈密卫，以其头目马哈麻火者等为指挥、千百户等官，又以周安为忠顺王长史，刘行为纪善，辅导。

translations.literal: In the third month the Hami Guard was established; chieftains such as Mahama Huozhe were made commanders, chiliarchs, centurions, and other officers, and Zhou An was appointed chief secretary to the King of Loyalty and Obedience, with Liu Xing as tutor, to guide and assist.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Hami Guard was established. Chieftains such as Mahama Huozhe were appointed commanders, chiliarchs, and centurions, while Zhou An was made chief secretary to the King of Loyalty and Obedience and Liu Xing tutor, to guide and assist the king.

sentences.zh: 冬，授头目十九人为都指挥等官。

translations.literal: In winter, nineteen chieftains were granted the ranks of regional commander and the like.
translations.idiomatic: That winter nineteen chieftains were appointed to posts such as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 明年，宋晟奏，头目陆十等作乱，已诛，虑他变，请兵防御。

translations.literal: The following year Song Sheng memorialized that the chieftain Lu Shi and others had rebelled and had already been executed; fearing further disturbances, he requested troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Song Sheng reported that the chieftain Lu Shi and others had risen in rebellion and been executed, but fearing further unrest he requested troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 帝命晟发兵应之，而以安克帖木儿妻子往依鬼力赤，恐诱贼侵哈密，敕晟谨备。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Song Sheng to dispatch troops in response, and because Anketiemuer's wife and children had gone to rely on Guilichi, fearing they might incite bandits to invade Hami, he instructed Song Sheng to prepare carefully.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Song Sheng to dispatch troops in response. Because Anketiemuer's wife and children had taken refuge with Guilichi, the emperor feared they might incite raiders against Hami and instructed Song Sheng to remain on strict guard.

sentences.zh: 晟卒，以何福代，又敕福开诚抚忠顺。

translations.literal: When Song Sheng died, He Fu replaced him, and the emperor again instructed He Fu to treat the King of Loyalty and Obedience with sincerity and kindness.
translations.idiomatic: When Song Sheng died, He Fu replaced him, and the emperor again instructed He Fu to treat the King of Loyalty and Obedience with sincerity and kindness.

sentences.zh: 会头目请设把总一人理国政，帝敕福曰：“置把总，是增一王也；

translations.literal: When the chieftains requested that a ba-zong be appointed to manage state affairs, the emperor instructed He Fu: 'To establish a ba-zong is to add another king;
translations.idiomatic: When the chieftains requested the appointment of a ba-zong to manage state affairs, the emperor instructed He Fu: "To establish a ba-zong is to create a second king;

sentences.zh: 政令不一，下安适从。”

translations.literal: if orders are not unified, whom are the people below to follow?'
translations.idiomatic: with divided authority, whom are the people below to obey?"

sentences.zh: 寝其议。

translations.literal: The proposal was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was rejected.

sentences.zh: 自是，比岁朝贡，悉加优赐，其使臣皆增秩授官。

translations.literal: From then on, tribute missions came every year and all received generous gifts; their envoys were all promoted in rank and granted offices.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Hami sent tribute every year and received generous rewards; its envoys were regularly promoted and granted official posts.

sentences.zh: 帝眷脱脱特厚，而脱脱顾凌侮朝使，沈湎昏聩，不恤国事，其下买柱等交谏不从。

translations.literal: The emperor favored Tuo Tuo especially, yet Tuo Tuo instead insulted imperial envoys, sank into drunkenness and stupor, and paid no heed to state affairs; subordinates such as Maizhu repeatedly remonstrated but he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor showed Tuo Tuo exceptional favor, yet Tuo Tuo insulted imperial envoys, sank into drunkenness and folly, and neglected state affairs. Subordinates such as Maizhu remonstrated with him repeatedly, but he would not listen.

sentences.zh: 帝闻之怒，八年十一月遣官赐敕戒谕之。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of this he was angry; in the eleventh month of the eighth year he sent officials bearing an edict to admonish him.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor learned of this he was furious. In the eleventh month of Yongle 8 he sent officials with an edict of admonition.

sentences.zh: 未至，而脱脱以暴疾卒。

translations.literal: Before they arrived, Tuo Tuo died suddenly of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Before the envoys arrived, Tuo Tuo died suddenly of illness.

sentences.zh: 讣闻，遣官赐祭。

translations.literal: When the death was reported, officials were sent to grant sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: When news of his death reached the court, officials were sent to perform sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 擢都指挥同知哈剌哈纳为都督佥事，镇守其地，赐敕及白金、彩币。

translations.literal: The assistant regional commander Halahana was promoted to assistant commissioner-in-chief, stationed to guard the region, and granted an edict together with silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant regional commander Halahana was promoted to assistant commissioner-in-chief and stationed to guard the region, receiving an edict together with silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 且封脱脱从弟兔力帖木儿为忠义王，赐印诰、玉带，世守哈密。

translations.literal: Moreover, Tuo Tuo's younger cousin Tulietiemuer was enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Righteousness, granted a seal, patent of appointment, and jade belt, to hold Hami in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Tuo's younger cousin Tulietiemuer was also enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Righteousness, granted a seal, patent of appointment, and jade belt, with the charge to hold Hami in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 十年，贡马谢恩，自是修贡惟谨，故王祖母亦数奉贡。

translations.literal: In the tenth year horses were presented in thanks; from then on tribute was offered with great care, and the former king's grandmother also sent tribute several times.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 10 they sent horses in gratitude. Thereafter tribute was offered with scrupulous care, and the former king's grandmother also sent tribute on several occasions.

sentences.zh: 十七年，帝以朝使往来西域者，忠义王致礼延接，命中官赍绮帛劳之，赐其母妻金珠冠服、彩币，及其部下头目。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, because envoys traveling to and from the Western Regions were received with courtesy by the King of Loyalty and Righteousness, the emperor ordered eunuchs to carry silks and brocades to reward him, granting his mother and wife gold-pearl crowns and robes, silks, and rewards to the chieftains under him.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 17, because the King of Loyalty and Righteousness had courteously received envoys traveling to and from the Western Regions, the emperor sent eunuchs bearing silks and brocades to reward him, granting his mother and wife gold-pearl crowns and robes, silks, and gifts to the chieftains under his command.

sentences.zh: 其使臣及境内回回寻贡马三千五百余匹及貂皮诸物，诏赐钞三万二千锭、绮百、帛一千。

translations.literal: His envoys and the Muslims within the territory soon presented more than three thousand five hundred horses and sable furs and other goods; an edict granted thirty-two thousand taels of paper money, one hundred rolls of patterned silk, and one thousand rolls of plain silk.
translations.idiomatic: His envoys and the Muslims within his territory soon presented more than three thousand five hundred horses along with sable furs and other goods. An edict granted thirty-two thousand strings of paper money, one hundred bolts of patterned silk, and one thousand bolts of plain silk.

sentences.zh: 二十一年贡驼三百三十、马千匹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year they presented three hundred thirty camels and one thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 21 they presented three hundred thirty camels and one thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 仁宗践阼，诏谕其国。

translations.literal: When the Renzong ascended the throne, an edict was issued to instruct their country.
translations.idiomatic: When the Renzong ascended the throne, an edict was sent to Hami.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年再入贡，贺即位。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi they again entered with tribute to congratulate him on his accession.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongxi 1 they sent tribute again to congratulate him on his accession.

sentences.zh: 仁宗崩，宣宗继统，其王兔力帖木儿亦卒，使来告哀。

translations.literal: When the Renzong died and the Xuanzong succeeded, their king Tulietiemuer also died, and envoys came to announce the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When the Renzong died and the Xuanzong succeeded, King Tulietiemuer also died, and envoys came to announce the mourning.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年遣官赐祭，命故王脱脱子卜答失里嗣忠顺王，且以登极肆赦，命其国中亦赦，复贡马谢恩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande officials were sent to grant sacrificial offerings; the former king Tuo Tuo's son Budashili was ordered to succeed as King of Loyalty and Obedience; and because of the general amnesty on the accession, the court ordered amnesty in their country as well; they again presented horses in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1 officials were sent to perform sacrificial rites, and the former king Tuo Tuo's son Budashili was appointed to succeed as King of Loyalty and Obedience. Because of the general amnesty proclaimed at the accession, the court ordered an amnesty in Hami as well, and they sent horses again in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 明年遣弟北斗奴等来朝，贡驼马方物。

translations.literal: The following year his younger brother Beidounu and others came to court and presented camels, horses, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: The following year his younger brother Beidounu and others came to court, presenting camels, horses, and local products.

sentences.zh: 授北斗奴都督佥事，因命中官谕王，遣故忠义王弟脱欢帖木儿赴京。

translations.literal: Beidounu was appointed assistant commissioner-in-chief; the emperor then ordered a eunuch to instruct the king to send the former King of Loyalty and Righteousness's younger brother Tuohuantiemuer to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Beidounu was appointed assistant commissioner-in-chief, and the emperor ordered a eunuch to instruct the king to send the former King of Loyalty and Righteousness's younger brother Tuohuantiemuer to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三年以卜答失里年幼，命脱欢帖木儿嗣忠义王，同理国事。

translations.literal: In the third year, because Budashili was young, Tuohuantiemuer was ordered to succeed as King of Loyalty and Righteousness and jointly manage state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 3, because Budashili was still young, Tuohuantiemuer was appointed to succeed as King of Loyalty and Righteousness and to manage state affairs jointly with him.

sentences.zh: 自是，二王并贡，岁或三四至，奏求婚娶礼币，命悉予之。

translations.literal: From then on both kings sent tribute together, three or four missions sometimes arriving in a year; when they memorialized requesting marriage gifts, the court ordered all to be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter both kings sent tribute together, sometimes three or four missions in a year. When they requested marriage gifts, the court ordered that all be granted.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，脫歡帖木兒卒，封其子脫脫塔木兒爲忠義王，未幾卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong, Tuohuantiemuer died; his son Tuotuotiemuer was enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Righteousness and soon also died.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 2 Tuohuantiemuer died. His son Tuotuotiemuer was enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Righteousness but soon died as well.

sentences.zh: 已而忠顺王亦卒，封其子倒瓦答失里为忠顺王。

translations.literal: Before long the King of Loyalty and Obedience also died; his son Daowadashili was enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Obedience.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the King of Loyalty and Obedience also died, and his son Daowadashili was enfeoffed in his place.

sentences.zh: 五年遣使三贡，廷议以为烦，定令每年一贡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year envoys were sent on three tribute missions; court discussion held this excessive and fixed the rule at one tribute mission per year.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 5 envoys came on three separate tribute missions. Court discussion deemed this excessive and fixed the rule at one mission per year.

sentences.zh: 初，成祖之封忠顺王也，以哈密为西域要道，欲其迎护朝使，统领诸番，为西陲屏蔽。

translations.literal: Initially, when the Chengzu enfeoffed the King of Loyalty and Obedience, it was because Hami was a vital route in the Western Regions; he wished him to receive and protect imperial envoys, command the various foreign peoples, and serve as a shield for the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chengzu first enfeoffed the King of Loyalty and Obedience, it was because Hami lay on a vital route into the Western Regions. He intended that the king receive and protect imperial envoys, command the various foreign peoples, and serve as a shield for the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 而其王率庸懦，又其地种落杂居。

translations.literal: Yet its kings were generally weak and cowardly, and the tribes of the region lived mixed together.
translations.idiomatic: Yet its kings proved generally weak and timid, and the tribes of the region lived intermixed.

sentences.zh: 一曰回回，一曰畏兀儿，一曰哈剌灰，其头目不相统属，王莫能节制。

translations.literal: One group was called Huihui, one Uyghur, one Khalaghui; their chieftains were not subordinate to one another, and the king could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: One group was called Huihui, another Uyghur, another Khalaghui. Their chieftains acknowledged no common authority, and the king could not control them.

sentences.zh: 众心离涣，国势渐衰。

translations.literal: Hearts were divided and scattered, and the state's strength gradually declined.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty fragmented and the kingdom's strength gradually waned.

sentences.zh: 及倒瓦答失里立，都督皮剌纳潜通瓦剌猛可卜花等谋杀王，不克。

translations.literal: When Daowadashili was installed, the commissioner Pilana secretly communicated with the Oirat Mengkebuhua and others to murder the king, but did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: When Daowadashili came to the throne, commissioner Pilana secretly colluded with the Oirat Mengkebuhua and others in a plot to murder the king, but the attempt failed.

sentences.zh: 王父在时，纳沙州叛亡百余家，屡敕王令还，止遣其半，其贡使又数辱驿吏卒，呵叱通事，当四方贡使大宴日，恶言诟詈，天子不加罪，但令慎择使臣，以是益无忌。

translations.literal: While the king's father was alive, he had taken in more than one hundred households of fugitives from Shazhou; the court repeatedly ordered the king to send them back, but he returned only half. His tribute envoys also repeatedly insulted postal clerks and runners, berating interpreters; on the day of the grand banquet for tribute envoys from all quarters they uttered vile abuse. The Son of Heaven did not punish them but only ordered careful selection of envoys—whereupon they grew all the more unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: During his father's reign the king had taken in more than one hundred fugitive households from Shazhou. The court repeatedly ordered their return, but only half were sent back. His tribute envoys repeatedly insulted postal clerks and runners and berated interpreters. At the grand banquet for envoys from all quarters they hurled vicious abuse. The emperor did not punish them but only ordered that envoys be chosen more carefully—and they grew all the more brazen.

sentences.zh: 其地，北瓦剌，西土鲁番，东沙州、罕东、赤斤诸卫，悉与构怨。

translations.literal: In its territory, to the north was the Oirat, to the west Turpan, to the east the guards of Shazhou, Handong, and Chijin—all bore grudges against it.
translations.idiomatic: Hami bordered the Oirat to the north, Turpan to the west, and the guards of Shazhou, Handong, and Chijin to the east—and had earned the enmity of them all.

sentences.zh: 由是邻国交侵。

translations.literal: Thereby neighboring states invaded one another in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring states therefore raided one another in turn.

sentences.zh: 罕东兵抵城外，掠人畜去。

translations.literal: Handong troops reached outside the city walls and carried off people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Handong troops reached the city walls and carried off people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 沙州、赤斤先后兵侵，皆大获。

translations.literal: Shazhou and Chijin invaded with troops in succession and all gained great spoils.
translations.idiomatic: Shazhou and Chijin invaded in succession and each reaped great spoils.

sentences.zh: 瓦剌酋也先，王母弩温答失里弟也，亦遣兵围哈密城，杀头目，俘男妇，掠牛马驼不可胜计，取王母及妻北还，胁王往见，王惧不敢往，数遣使告难。

translations.literal: The Oirat chieftain Esen, younger brother of the queen mother Nuwendashili, also sent troops to besiege Hami city, killed chieftains, captured men and women, and plundered cattle, horses, and camels beyond counting; he took the queen mother and the queen north and compelled the king to come see him. The king was afraid and did not dare go, repeatedly sending envoys to report his distress.
translations.idiomatic: The Oirat chieftain Esen, younger brother of Queen Mother Nuwendashili, also sent troops to besiege Hami. They killed chieftains, captured men and women, and plundered cattle, horses, and camels beyond count. Esen took the queen mother and the queen north and demanded that the king come before him. The king was terrified and dared not go, sending envoys repeatedly to report his plight.

sentences.zh: 敕令诸部修好，迄不从，惟王母妻获还。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the various groups to restore friendly relations, but they never obeyed; only the queen mother and queen were recovered and returned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the various parties to restore friendly relations, but they never complied. Only the queen mother and queen were eventually recovered and returned.

sentences.zh: 十年，也先复取王母妻及弟，并撒马儿罕贡使百余人掠之，又数趣王往见。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Esen again seized the queen mother, queen, and younger brother, and also plundered more than one hundred tribute envoys from Samarqand; he again repeatedly urged the king to come see him.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 10 Esen again seized the queen mother, queen, and the king's younger brother, and plundered more than one hundred tribute envoys from Samarqand. He again repeatedly demanded that the king come before him.

sentences.zh: 王外顺朝命，实惧也先。

translations.literal: Outwardly the king obeyed the court's orders, but in fact he feared Esen.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly the king obeyed the court's orders, but in truth he feared Esen.

sentences.zh: 十三年夏，亲诣瓦剌，居数月方还；

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirteenth year he went in person to the Oirat and stayed several months before returning;
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Zhengtong 13 he went in person to the Oirat and remained several months before returning;

sentences.zh: 而遣使诳天子，谓守朝命不敢往。

translations.literal: yet he sent envoys to deceive the Son of Heaven, saying he observed the court's command and did not dare go.
translations.idiomatic: yet he sent envoys to deceive the emperor, claiming that he was obeying the court's command and dared not go.

sentences.zh: 天子为赐敕褒嘉。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven thereupon granted an edict praising and rewarding him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor responded with an edict of praise and reward.

sentences.zh: 已，知其诈，严旨诘责，然其王迄不能自振。

translations.literal: Later, when the deception was known, a stern edict rebuked him, yet the king to the end could not recover his strength.
translations.idiomatic: When the deception was discovered, a stern edict rebuked him, yet the king never recovered his authority.

sentences.zh: 会也先方东犯，不复还故土，以是哈密获少安。

translations.literal: It happened that Esen was then invading eastward and did not return to his old territory; thereby Hami obtained a brief respite.
translations.idiomatic: Esen was then invading eastward and did not return to his old territory, and Hami thus enjoyed a brief respite.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年遣其臣捏列沙朝贡，请授官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingtai his minister Nieliesha came to court with tribute and requested appointment to office.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 3 his minister Nieliesha came to court with tribute and requested an official appointment.

sentences.zh: 先是，使臣至京必加恩命。

translations.literal: Previously, whenever envoys reached the capital they were invariably granted honors and appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, envoys reaching the capital had invariably been granted honors and appointments.

sentences.zh: 是时于谦掌中枢，言哈密世受国恩，乃敢交通瓦剌。

translations.literal: At this time Yu Qian controlled the central command and said that Hami had long received the state's grace yet dared to communicate with the Oirat.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Yu Qian held command of the central military administration and argued that Hami, long favored by the state, had dared to communicate with the Oirat.

sentences.zh: 今虽归款，心犹谲诈。

translations.literal: Now although they have returned to allegiance, their hearts remain deceitful.
translations.idiomatic: Though they had now returned to allegiance, their hearts remained deceitful.

sentences.zh: 若加官秩，赏出无名。

translations.literal: If rank were added, the reward would be without justification.
translations.idiomatic: To grant them rank would be to reward them without cause.

sentences.zh: 乃止。

translations.literal: The matter was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The appointment was denied.

sentences.zh: 终景泰世，使臣无授官者。

translations.literal: Throughout the Jingtai reign no envoys were granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Jingtai reign no Hami envoys received official appointments.

sentences.zh: 天顺元年，倒瓦答失里卒，弟卜列革遣使告哀，即封为忠顺王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun, Daowadashili died; his younger brother Bolige sent envoys to announce the mourning and was immediately enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Obedience.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 Daowadashili died. His younger brother Bolige sent envoys to announce the mourning and was immediately enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Obedience.

sentences.zh: 时都指挥马云使西域，闻迤北酋癿加思兰梗道，不敢进。

translations.literal: At that time the regional commander Ma Yun was envoy to the Western Regions; hearing that the northern chieftain Qie Qaslan was blocking the road, he did not dare advance.
translations.idiomatic: At that time regional commander Ma Yun was traveling as envoy to the Western Regions. Hearing that the northern chieftain Qie Qaslan was blocking the route, he did not dare proceed.

sentences.zh: 会哈密王报道已通，云乃行，至哈密。

translations.literal: When the Hami king reported that the route was clear, Ma Yun then set out and reached Hami.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hami king reported that the route was clear, Ma Yun set out and reached Hami.

sentences.zh: 而贼兵实未退，且谋劫朝使。

translations.literal: But the bandit troops had in fact not withdrawn and were plotting to rob the imperial envoy.
translations.idiomatic: But the raiders had in fact not withdrawn and were plotting to ambush the imperial envoy.

sentences.zh: 帝疑王与贼通，遣使切责。

translations.literal: The emperor suspected the king of colluding with the bandits and sent envoys to rebuke him sharply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected the king of colluding with the raiders and sent envoys to rebuke him sharply.

sentences.zh: 四年，王卒，无子，母弩温答失里主国事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the king died without a son; his mother Nuwendashili managed state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 4 the king died without an heir, and his mother Nuwendashili assumed control of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 初，也先被诛，其弟伯都王及从子兀忽纳走居哈密。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Esen was executed, his younger brother the Prince of Berdu and his nephew Wuhuna fled to live in Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Esen was executed, his younger brother the Prince of Berdu and his nephew Wuhuna had fled to Hami.

sentences.zh: 王母爲上書乞恩，授伯都王都督僉事，兀忽納指揮僉事。

translations.literal: The queen mother memorialized the throne begging favor; the Prince of Berdu was appointed assistant commissioner-in-chief and Wuhuna assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: The queen mother petitioned the throne for favor on their behalf. The Prince of Berdu was appointed assistant commissioner-in-chief and Wuhuna assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 自卜列革之亡，亲属无可继，命国人议当袭者。

translations.literal: Since Bolige's death there was no kinsman to succeed; the court ordered the people of the country to discuss who should inherit.
translations.idiomatic: Since Bolige's death no kinsman was available to succeed. The court ordered the people of Hami to discuss who should inherit the kingship.

sentences.zh: 头目阿只等言脱欢帖木儿外孙把塔木儿官都督同知，可继。

translations.literal: The chieftain Aji and others said that Batu Tiemuer, grandson of Tuohuantiemuer, held the rank of assistant regional commander and could succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain Aji and others argued that Batu Tiemuer, grandson of Tuohuantiemuer and holder of the rank of assistant regional commander, was fit to succeed.

sentences.zh: 王母谓臣不可继君，而安定王阿儿察与忠顺王同祖，为请袭封。

translations.literal: The queen mother said a subject could not succeed a ruler, and because the Prince of Anding, A'ercha, shared ancestry with the King of Loyalty and Obedience, she requested enfeoffment for him.
translations.idiomatic: The queen mother argued that a subject could not succeed a sovereign, and because the Prince of Anding, A'ercha, shared ancestry with the King of Loyalty and Obedience, she petitioned for his enfeoffment instead.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，奏上，礼官言：“癿加思兰见哈密无主，谋据其地，势危急，乞从其请。”

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year the memorial was submitted; the ritual officials said: 'Qie Qaslan, seeing Hami without a ruler, plans to seize its territory; the situation is critical—please grant her request.'
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Tianshun 7 the memorial reached the throne. The ritual officials argued: "Qie Qaslan, seeing Hami without a ruler, plans to seize its territory. The situation is critical—please grant her request."

sentences.zh: 帝命都指挥贺玉往。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the regional commander He Yu to go.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered regional commander He Yu to proceed.

sentences.zh: 至西宁逗遛不进，哈密使臣苦儿鲁海牙请先行，又不许。

translations.literal: When he reached Xining he lingered and would not advance; the Hami envoy Ku'erluhaiya requested to go ahead first, but this too was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He reached Xining but lingered there without advancing. The Hami envoy Ku'erluhaiya requested permission to go ahead, but this was denied.

sentences.zh: 帝逮玉下吏，改命都指挥李珍，而敕安定、罕东护使臣偕往。

translations.literal: The emperor arrested He Yu and handed him over to the judicial authorities, changed the appointment to the regional commander Li Zhen, and ordered Anding and Handong to escort the envoys together.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had He Yu arrested and handed over to the judicial authorities, replaced him with regional commander Li Zhen, and ordered Anding and Handong to escort the envoys together.

sentences.zh: 阿儿察以哈密多难，力辞不行，珍乃返。

translations.literal: A'ercha, citing Hami's many troubles, firmly declined to go; Li Zhen then returned.
translations.idiomatic: A'ercha, citing Hami's many troubles, firmly declined to go, and Li Zhen returned without completing the mission.

sentences.zh: 哈密素衰微，又妇人主国，众益离散。

translations.literal: Hami had long been weak, and with a woman ruling the state the people grew all the more scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Hami had long been in decline, and with a woman ruling the state its people grew ever more scattered.

sentences.zh: 癿加思兰乘隙袭破其城，大肆杀掠，王母率亲属部落走苦峪，犹数遣使朝贡，且告难。

translations.literal: Qie Qaslan seized the opportunity to attack and break its city, slaughtering and plundering on a great scale; the queen mother led kinsmen and tribes to flee to Kuyu, yet still repeatedly sent envoys to court with tribute and to report distress.
translations.idiomatic: Qie Qaslan seized the opportunity to attack and capture the city, slaughtering and plundering on a great scale. The queen mother led her kinsmen and tribes in flight to Kuyu, yet still sent envoys repeatedly to court with tribute and pleas for help.

sentences.zh: 朝廷不能援，但敕其国人速议当继者而已。

translations.literal: The court could not send aid but only issued an edict ordering the people of the country to quickly discuss who should succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The court could not send aid and could only instruct the people of Hami to quickly decide who should succeed.

sentences.zh: 其国残以破故，来者日众。

translations.literal: Because the country was devastated by destruction, those who came grew daily in number.
translations.idiomatic: Because the kingdom lay in ruins, refugees arriving at the court grew daily in number.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，礼官姚夔等言：“哈密贡马二百匹，而使人乃二百六十人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua the ritual official Yao Kui and others said: 'Hami presented two hundred horses in tribute, yet the envoys numbered two hundred sixty persons.'
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 1 the ritual official Yao Kui and others argued: "Hami presented two hundred horses in tribute, yet its envoys numbered two hundred sixty persons."

sentences.zh: 以中国有限之财，供外蕃无益之费，非策。”

translations.literal: To use China's limited wealth to supply useless expenses for foreign tribes is not a good policy.
translations.idiomatic: To expend China's limited resources on wasteful costs for foreign tribes is poor policy.

sentences.zh: 帝下廷臣议，定岁一入贡，不得过二百人，制可。

translations.literal: The emperor submitted the matter to court officials for discussion; they fixed one tribute mission per year with no more than two hundred persons, and the regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor referred the matter to court officials, who fixed the rule at one tribute mission per year with no more than two hundred persons. The regulation was approved.

sentences.zh: 明年，兵部言王母避苦峪久，今贼兵已退，宜令还故土，从之。

translations.literal: The following year the Ministry of War said the queen mother had long taken refuge at Kuyu and the bandit troops had now withdrawn; she should be ordered to return to her old territory. The proposal was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Ministry of War argued that the queen mother had long taken refuge at Kuyu and that now the raiders had withdrawn, she should be ordered to return to her old territory. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 已而贡使言其地饥寒，男妇二百余人随来丐食，不能归国。

translations.literal: Before long the tribute envoys reported that the region suffered from hunger and cold; more than two hundred men and women had come along begging food and could not return home.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the tribute envoys reported that the region suffered famine and cold. More than two hundred men and women had come along begging food and could not return home.

sentences.zh: 命人给米六斗、布二疋，遣之。

translations.literal: Each person was given six dou of grain and two bolts of cloth and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered that each person receive six dou of grain and two bolts of cloth, then be sent on their way.

sentences.zh: 初，国人请立把塔木儿，以王母不肯，无王者八年。

translations.literal: Initially the people of the country requested that Batu Tiemuer be installed, but because the queen mother refused, there was no king for eight years.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the people of Hami had requested that Batu Tiemuer be installed as king, but the queen mother refused, and Hami went eight years without a king.

sentences.zh: 至是头目交章请，词极哀。

translations.literal: At this point the chieftains submitted memorials one after another, their words extremely sorrowful.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the chieftains submitted memorial after memorial in the most piteous terms.

sentences.zh: 乃擢把塔木儿为右都督，摄行国王事，赐之诰印。

translations.literal: Batu Tiemuer was then promoted to right regional commander, entrusted to act in the king's affairs, and granted a patent of appointment and seal.
translations.idiomatic: Batu Tiemuer was then promoted to right regional commander, entrusted to act in the king's stead, and granted a patent of appointment and seal.

sentences.zh: 五年，王母陈老病乞药物，帝即赐之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the queen mother reported old age and illness and begged for medicine; the emperor immediately granted it.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 5 the queen mother reported old age and illness and begged for medicine. The emperor immediately granted her request.

sentences.zh: 寻与瓦刺、土鲁番遣使三百余人来贡，边臣以闻。

translations.literal: Soon more than three hundred envoys came with tribute together from the Oirat and Turpan; border officials reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Soon more than three hundred envoys from the Oirat and Turpan arrived together with tribute, and border officials reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 廷议贡有定期，今前使未回后使又至，且瓦剌强寇，今乃与哈密偕；

translations.literal: Court discussion held that tribute had fixed periods; now the previous envoys had not returned before new envoys arrived, and the Oirat were powerful bandits yet now came together with Hami;
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion noted that tribute missions had fixed schedules, yet the previous envoys had not returned before new ones arrived. The Oirat were powerful raiders, yet now they came together with Hami;

sentences.zh: 非哈密挟其势以邀利，即瓦剌假其事以窥边。

translations.literal: either Hami was using their strength to seek profit, or the Oirat were using the occasion to probe the border.
translations.idiomatic: either Hami was using their combined strength to seek profit, or the Oirat were using the occasion to probe the frontier.

sentences.zh: 帝乃却其献，令边臣宴赉，遣还。

translations.literal: The emperor therefore rejected their tribute, ordered border officials to feast and reward them, and sent them back.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore rejected their tribute, ordered border officials to feast and reward them, and sent them back.

sentences.zh: 贡使坚不受赐，必欲亲诣阙下，乃命遣十之一赴京。

translations.literal: The tribute envoys firmly refused the gifts and insisted on going in person to the palace; only one in ten was ordered to proceed to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The tribute envoys firmly refused the gifts and insisted on going in person to the palace. Only one in ten was permitted to proceed to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八年，把塔木儿子罕慎以父卒请嗣职。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Batu Tiemuer's son Hanshen requested to succeed to his father's post upon his death.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 8 Batu Tiemuer's son Hanshen, upon his father's death, requested to succeed to his post.

sentences.zh: 帝许之，而不命其主国事，国中政令无所出。

translations.literal: The emperor consented but did not order him to manage state affairs; within the country no orders issued forth.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consented but did not authorize him to manage state affairs, and no effective authority issued from within Hami.

sentences.zh: 土鲁番速檀阿力乘机袭破其城，执王母，夺金印，以忠顺王孙女为妾，据守其地。

translations.literal: The Turpan sultan Ali seized the opportunity to attack and break its city, seized the queen mother, took the gold seal, took the King of Loyalty and Obedience's granddaughter as concubine, and occupied and held the territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Turpan sultan Ali seized the opportunity to attack and capture the city. He seized the queen mother, took the gold seal, took the King of Loyalty and Obedience's granddaughter as concubine, and occupied the territory.

sentences.zh: 九年四月，事闻，命边臣谨戒备，敕罕东、赤斤诸卫协力战守。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the ninth year, when the matter was reported, border officials were ordered to prepare carefully and Handong, Chijin, and other guards were instructed to fight and defend together.
translations.idiomatic: When news reached the court in the fourth month of Chenghua 9, border officials were ordered to prepare carefully, and Handong, Chijin, and other guards were instructed to fight and defend together.

sentences.zh: 寻遣都督同知李文、右通政刘文赴甘肃经略。

translations.literal: Soon the assistant commissioner-in-chief Li Wen and the right vice commissioner Liu Wen were sent to Gansu to manage the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The court soon dispatched assistant commissioner-in-chief Li Wen and right vice commissioner Liu Wen to Gansu to manage the campaign.

sentences.zh: 抵肃州，遣锦衣千户马俊奉敕往谕。

translations.literal: When they reached Suzhou, they dispatched the brocade-clad guard chiliarch Ma Jun bearing an edict to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching Suzhou they dispatched brocade-clad guard chiliarch Ma Jun bearing an edict to deliver the court's instructions.

sentences.zh: 时阿力留其妹婿牙兰守哈密，而己携王母、金印已返土鲁番。

translations.literal: At that time Ali left his sister's husband Yalan to guard Hami, while he himself had already returned to Turpan with the queen mother and gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ali had left his brother-in-law Yalan to hold Hami while he himself had already returned to Turpan with the queen mother and the gold seal.

sentences.zh: 俊至，谕以朝命，抗词不逊，羁俊月余。

translations.literal: When Ma Jun arrived and conveyed the court's command, Yalan answered with defiant and disrespectful words and detained Ma Jun for more than a month.
translations.idiomatic: When Ma Jun arrived and conveyed the court's command, Yalan answered with defiant and disrespectful words and detained him for more than a month.

sentences.zh: 一日，牙兰忽至，言大兵三万即日西来，阿力乃宴劳俊等，舁王母出见。

translations.literal: One day Yalan suddenly arrived, saying that a great army of thirty thousand would come west that very day; Ali then feasted and rewarded Ma Jun and the others and had the queen mother carried out to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: One day Yalan suddenly appeared, claiming that a great army of thirty thousand would arrive from the west that very day. Ali then feasted Ma Jun and his party and had the queen mother brought out to meet them.

sentences.zh: 王母惧不敢言，夜潜遣人来云：“为我奏天子，速发兵救哈密。”

translations.literal: The queen mother was afraid and did not dare speak; at night she secretly sent someone saying: 'Memorialize the Son of Heaven for me—send troops quickly to save Hami.'
translations.idiomatic: The queen mother was terrified and dared not speak. That night she secretly sent someone with the message: "Memorialize the Son of Heaven for me—send troops quickly to save Hami."

sentences.zh: 文等以闻，遂檄都督罕慎及赤斤、罕东、乜克力诸部集兵进讨。

translations.literal: Liu Wen and the others reported this, and then issued orders to the commissioner Hanshen and the departments of Chijin, Handong, and Yikelie to gather troops and advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wen and his colleagues reported this, then issued orders to commissioner Hanshen and the Chijin, Handong, and Yikelie tribes to gather troops and advance against the enemy.

sentences.zh: 十年冬，兵至卜隆吉儿川，谍报阿力集众抗拒，且结别部谋掠罕东、赤斤二卫。

translations.literal: In the winter of the tenth year the army reached the Bolongji'er River; spies reported that Ali had gathered forces to resist and had allied with other tribes plotting to raid the two guards of Handong and Chijin.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Chenghua 10 the army reached the Bolongji'er River. Spies reported that Ali had gathered forces to resist and had allied with other tribes to raid Handong and Chijin.

sentences.zh: 文等不敢进，令二卫还守本土，罕慎及乜克力、畏兀儿之众退居苦峪，文等亦引还肃州。

translations.literal: Liu Wen and the others did not dare advance; they ordered the two guards to return and defend their own territories, Hanshen and the forces of Yikelie and the Uyghurs withdrew to Kuyu, and Liu Wen and the others also withdrew to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wen and his colleagues did not dare advance. They ordered the two guards to return and defend their own territories, Hanshen and the Yikelie and Uyghur forces withdrew to Kuyu, and Liu Wen's party retreated to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝乃命罕慎权主国事，因其请给米布，且赐以谷种。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered Hanshen to manage state affairs provisionally; because he requested grain and cloth, seed grain was also granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then authorized Hanshen to manage state affairs provisionally. At his request the court granted grain and cloth, and also provided seed grain.

sentences.zh: 文等无功而还。

translations.literal: Liu Wen and the others returned without achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wen and his colleagues returned without achieving anything.

sentences.zh: 土鲁番久据哈密，朝命边臣筑苦峪城，移哈密卫于其地。

translations.literal: Turpan long occupied Hami; the court ordered border officials to build Kuyu city and move the Hami Guard to that place.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan had long occupied Hami, and the court ordered border officials to build Kuyu city and relocate the Hami Guard there.

sentences.zh: 十八年春，罕慎纠罕东、赤斤二卫，得兵一千三百人，与己所部共万人，夜袭哈密城破之，牙兰遁走；

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighteenth year Hanshen rallied the two guards of Handong and Chijin, obtaining one thousand three hundred troops; together with his own forces they numbered ten thousand and made a night attack, breaking Hami city; Yalan fled;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Chenghua 18 Hanshen rallied Handong and Chijin, obtaining thirteen hundred troops. Together with his own forces they numbered ten thousand and launched a night attack that captured Hami. Yalan fled;

sentences.zh: 乘势连复八城，遂还居故土。

translations.literal: Seizing the momentum they recovered eight cities in succession and then returned to dwell in their old territory.
translations.idiomatic: Seizing the momentum they recovered eight cities in succession and returned to their old territory.

sentences.zh: 巡抚王朝远以闻，帝喜，赐敕奖励，并奖二卫。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator Wang Chaoyuan reported this; the emperor was pleased, granted an edict of reward, and also rewarded the two guards.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinator Wang Chaoyuan reported the victory. The emperor was delighted, issued an edict of reward, and also commended the two guards.

sentences.zh: 朝远请封罕慎为王，且言土鲁番亦革心向化，与罕慎议和，宜乘时安抚，取还王孙女及金印，俾随王母共掌国事，哈密国人亦乞封罕慎。

translations.literal: Wang Chaoyuan requested that Hanshen be enfeoffed as king, and also said that Turpan had reformed its heart and turned toward civilization, negotiating peace with Hanshen; the time should be seized to pacify them, recover the king's granddaughter and gold seal, and have her manage state affairs together with the queen mother; the people of Hami also begged that Hanshen be enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chaoyuan requested that Hanshen be enfeoffed as king. He also reported that Turpan had reformed and sought peace with Hanshen, and argued that the court should seize the moment to pacify the region, recover the king's granddaughter and the gold seal, and have her manage state affairs jointly with the queen mother. The people of Hami also petitioned for Hanshen's enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 廷议不从，乃进左都督，赉白金百两、彩币十表里，特敕奖劳，将士升赏有差。

translations.literal: Court discussion did not agree; he was instead promoted to left regional commander, granted one hundred taels of silver and ten rolls of patterned silk inside and out, specially rewarded by edict, and officers and soldiers were promoted and rewarded according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion rejected the proposal. Hanshen was instead promoted to left regional commander, granted one hundred taels of silver and ten rolls of patterned silk, specially commended by edict, and officers and soldiers were promoted and rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年从其国人请，封罕慎为忠顺王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongzhi, acceding to the request of the people of the country, Hanshen was enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Obedience.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 1, acceding to the petition of the people of Hami, Hanshen was enfeoffed as King of Loyalty and Obedience.

sentences.zh: 土鲁番阿力已死，而其子阿黑麻嗣为速檀，伪与罕慎结婚，诱而杀之，仍令牙兰据其地。

translations.literal: Turpan's Ali had already died, and his son Aheima succeeded as sultan; feigning a marriage alliance with Hanshen, he lured and killed him, and again had Yalan hold the territory.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan's Ali had died, and his son Aheima succeeded as sultan. Feigning a marriage alliance with Hanshen, he lured and killed him, and again placed Yalan in control of the territory.

sentences.zh: 哈密都指挥阿木郎来奔求救，廷臣请谕土鲁番贡使，令复还侵地，并敕赤斤、罕东，共图兴复。

translations.literal: Hami's regional commander Amulang came fleeing to beg for rescue; court officials requested that Turpan's tribute envoys be instructed to restore the seized territory, and Chijin and Handong be ordered to plan recovery together.
translations.idiomatic: Hami's regional commander Amulang fled to the border begging for rescue. Court officials proposed instructing Turpan's tribute envoys to restore the seized territory and ordering Chijin and Handong to plan recovery together.

sentences.zh: 明年，哈密旧部绰卜都等率众攻牙兰，杀其弟，夺其叛臣者盼卜等人畜以归。

translations.literal: The following year Chuo Baidu and others of Hami's old followers led troops to attack Yalan, killed his younger brother, and seized the people and livestock of the rebel minister Zhepanbu and others and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Chuo Baidu and others of Hami's old followers led troops against Yalan, killed his younger brother, and seized the people and livestock of the rebel minister Zhepanbu and his followers before returning.

sentences.zh: 事闻，进秩加赏。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, ranks were advanced and additional rewards granted.
translations.idiomatic: When news reached the court, ranks were advanced and additional rewards granted.

sentences.zh: 先是，罕慎遣使来贡，未还而遘难，其弟奄克孛剌率部众逃之边方，朝命以赐罕慎者还赐其弟。

translations.literal: Earlier Hanshen had sent envoys with tribute; before they returned disaster struck; his younger brother Yanke Bolie led the tribes in flight to the border region; the court ordered that what had been granted to Hanshen be returned and given to his younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Hanshen had sent envoys with tribute, but before they returned disaster struck. His younger brother Yanke Bolie led the tribes in flight to the border. The court ordered that what had been granted to Hanshen be given to his brother instead.

sentences.zh: 阿黑麻之去哈密也，止留六十人佐牙兰。

translations.literal: When Aheima left Hami, he left only sixty men to assist Yalan.
translations.idiomatic: When Aheima left Hami, he left only sixty men to assist Yalan.

sentences.zh: 阿木郎觇其单弱，请边臣调赤斤、罕东兵，夜袭破其城，牙兰遁去，斩获甚多，有诏奖赉。

translations.literal: Amulang, seeing their weakness, requested border officials to mobilize Chijin and Handong troops; they made a night attack and broke the city; Yalan fled; many were killed and captured; an edict granted rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Amulang, seeing their weakness, requested that border officials mobilize Chijin and Handong troops. A night attack captured the city, Yalan fled, and many were killed or captured. An edict granted rewards.

sentences.zh: 当是时，阿黑麻桀傲甚，自以地远中国，屡抗天子命。

translations.literal: At this time Aheima was extremely arrogant and rebellious; considering his land far from China, he repeatedly resisted the Son of Heaven's commands.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Aheima was extremely arrogant and rebellious. Considering his land far from China, he repeatedly defied the emperor's commands.

sentences.zh: 及破哈密，贡使频至，朝廷仍善待之，由是益轻中国。

translations.literal: After breaking Hami, tribute envoys came frequently, yet the court still treated them well; thereby he came to despise China all the more.
translations.idiomatic: After capturing Hami, tribute envoys came frequently, yet the court still treated them well—and he grew all the more contemptuous of China.

sentences.zh: 帝乃薄其赐赉，或拘留使臣，却其贡物，敕责令悔罪。

translations.literal: The emperor then reduced their gifts, sometimes detained envoys, rejected their tribute goods, and issued edicts ordering them to repent their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then reduced their rewards, sometimes detained envoys, rejected their tribute goods, and issued edicts demanding repentance.

sentences.zh: 已，访获忠顺王族孙陕巴，将辅立之。

translations.literal: Later, Shanba, a clansman of the King of Zhongshun, was found and was to be installed with assistance.
translations.idiomatic: Later the court located Shanba, a clansman of the King of Zhongshun, and planned to install him with assistance.

sentences.zh: 阿黑麻渐警惧，三年遣使叩关，愿献还哈密及金印，释其拘留使臣。

translations.literal: Aheima gradually grew alarmed and fearful; in the third year he sent envoys to knock at the pass, willing to return Hami and the gold seal and release the detained envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Aheima gradually grew alarmed. In Hongzhi 3 he sent envoys to the frontier pass, offering to return Hami and the gold seal and release the detained envoys.

sentences.zh: 天子纳其贡，仍留前使者。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven accepted their tribute but still detained the previous envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted their tribute but still detained the previous envoys.

sentences.zh: 明年，果以城印来归，乃从马文升言，还其所拘使臣。

translations.literal: The following year they indeed returned the city and seal; following Ma Wensheng's advice, the detained envoys were released.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they indeed returned the city and seal. Following Ma Wensheng's advice, the court released the detained envoys.

sentences.zh: 文升又言：“番人重种类，且素服蒙古，哈密故有回回、畏兀儿、哈剌灰三种，北山又有小列秃、乜克力相侵逼，非得蒙古后裔镇之不可。

translations.literal: Ma Wensheng also said: 'The foreign tribes value lineage, and have long submitted to the Mongols. Hami originally had three groups—Huihui, Uyghur, and Khalaghui—and in the northern mountains Xiaolietu and Yikelie also press and threaten one another; only a Mongol descendant can govern them.'
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wensheng also argued: "The foreign tribes value lineage and have long submitted to the Mongols. Hami originally had three groups—Huihui, Uyghur, and Khalaghui—and in the northern mountains Xiaolietu and Yikelie also threaten one another. Only a Mongol descendant can govern them."

sentences.zh: 今安定王族人陕巴，乃故忠义王脱脱近属从孙，可主哈密。”

translations.literal: Now Shanba of the Prince of Anding's clan is a close collateral great-grandson of the former King of Loyalty and Righteousness Tuo Tuo; he can rule Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Shanba of the Prince of Anding's clan is a close collateral great-grandson of the former King of Loyalty and Righteousness Tuo Tuo and is fit to rule Hami.

sentences.zh: 天子以为然，而诸番亦共奏陕巴当立。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven thought this correct, and the various foreign tribes also jointly memorialized that Shanba should be installed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed, and the various foreign tribes also jointly memorialized that Shanba should be installed.

sentences.zh: 五年春立陕巴为忠顺王，赐印诰、冠服及守城戎器，擢阿木郎都督佥事，与都督同知奄克孛剌共辅之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Shanba was installed as King of Loyalty and Obedience; he was granted seal, patent, crown and robes, and city-defense weapons; Amulang was promoted to assistant commissioner-in-chief and together with assistant commissioner Yanke Bolie assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Hongzhi 5 Shanba was installed as King of Loyalty and Obedience, granted seal, patent, crown and robes, and city-defense weapons. Amulang was promoted to assistant commissioner-in-chief and together with assistant commissioner Yanke Bolie was appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 已而诸番索陕巴犒赐不得，皆怨。

translations.literal: Before long the various tribes, not receiving rewards from Shanba, all bore resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the various tribes, having received no rewards from Shanba, all grew resentful.

sentences.zh: 阿木郎又引乜克力人掠土鲁番牛马，阿黑麻怒，六年春潜兵夜袭哈密，杀其人百余，逃及降者各半。

translations.literal: Amulang also led Yikelie people to plunder Turpan's cattle and horses; Aheima was angry; in the spring of the sixth year he secretly sent troops in a night raid on Hami, killing more than one hundred of its people; half fled and half surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Amulang also led Yikelie raiders to plunder Turpan's cattle and horses. Aheima was furious. In the spring of Hongzhi 6 he secretly sent troops in a night raid on Hami, killing more than a hundred people. Half fled and half surrendered.

sentences.zh: 陕巴与阿木郎据大土剌以守。

translations.literal: Shanba and Amulang held the Great Tula to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Shanba and Amulang held the Great Tula to defend themselves.

sentences.zh: 大土剌，華言大土臺也。

translations.literal: Great Tula—in Chinese, the Great Earthen Platform.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Tula—in Chinese, the Great Earthen Platform.

sentences.zh: 围三日不下。

translations.literal: They besieged it for three days without taking it.
translations.idiomatic: The besiegers assaulted it for three days without success.

sentences.zh: 阿木郎急调乜克力、瓦剌二部兵来援，俱败去。

translations.literal: Amulang urgently mobilized troops from the Yikelie and Oirat tribes to come to the rescue; all were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Amulang urgently mobilized Yikelie and Oirat reinforcements, but all were defeated and driven off.

sentences.zh: 乃执陕巴，擒阿木郎支解之。

translations.literal: They then seized Shanba and captured Amulang, dismembering him.
translations.idiomatic: They then seized Shanba and captured Amulang, whom they dismembered.

sentences.zh: 牙兰复据守，并移书边臣诉阿木郎罪。

translations.literal: Yalan again occupied and held the territory, and also sent a letter to border officials accusing Amulang of crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Yalan again occupied the territory and sent a letter to border officials accusing Amulang of crimes.

sentences.zh: 时土鲁番先后贡使皆未还。

translations.literal: At this time Turpan's successive tribute envoys had not yet returned.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Turpan's successive tribute envoys had not yet returned.

sentences.zh: 边臣以其书不逊，且僭称可汗，乞命将遣兵先剿除牙兰，然后直抵土鲁番，馘阿黑麻之首，取还陕巴。

translations.literal: Border officials, because the letter was disrespectful and he presumptuously styled himself khan, begged that generals be ordered to dispatch troops first to eliminate Yalan, then proceed straight to Turpan, cut off Aheima's head, and recover Shanba.
translations.idiomatic: Border officials, finding the letter disrespectful and noting that he presumptuously styled himself khan, requested that generals be ordered first to eliminate Yalan, then proceed straight to Turpan, cut off Aheima's head, and recover Shanba.

sentences.zh: 否则降敕严责，令还陕巴，乃宥其罪。

translations.literal: Otherwise issue a stern edict of rebuke, order the return of Shanba, and then pardon their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Alternatively, issue a stern edict demanding the return of Shanba, and then pardon their crimes.

sentences.zh: 廷议从后策，令守臣拘贡使，纵数人还，赍敕晓示祸福。

translations.literal: Court discussion favored the latter plan: border officials were to detain the tribute envoys, release a few to return, and send them bearing an edict explaining fortune and disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion favored the latter plan: border officials were to detain the tribute envoys, release a few to return bearing an edict explaining the consequences.

sentences.zh: 帝如其请，命廷推大臣赴甘肃经略。

translations.literal: The emperor granted their request and ordered the court to recommend a senior minister to go to Gansu to manage the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted their request and ordered the court to recommend a senior minister to go to Gansu to manage the campaign.

sentences.zh: 初，哈密变闻，丘浚谓马文升曰：“西陲事重，须公一行。”

translations.literal: Initially, when news of the Hami crisis was heard, Qiu Jun said to Ma Wensheng: 'Western frontier affairs are weighty—you must go in person.'
translations.idiomatic: When news of the Hami crisis reached the court, Qiu Jun said to Ma Wensheng: "Western frontier affairs are weighty—you must go in person."

sentences.zh: 文升曰：“国家有事，臣子义不辞难。

translations.literal: Ma Wensheng said: 'When the state has affairs, ministers and subjects by duty do not shrink from difficulty.'
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wensheng replied: "When the state has urgent business, ministers and subjects by duty do not shrink from difficulty."

sentences.zh: 然番人嗜利，不善骑射，自古未有西域能为中国患者，徐当靖之。”

translations.literal: Yet the foreign tribes covet profit and are not skilled in riding and shooting; since antiquity the Western Regions have never been able to trouble China—they should be pacified gradually.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the foreign tribes covet profit and are poor horsemen and archers. Since antiquity the Western Regions have never truly threatened China—they should be pacified gradually.

sentences.zh: 浚复以为言，文升请行。

translations.literal: Qiu Jun spoke of it again, and Ma Wensheng requested to go.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Jun pressed the point again, and Ma Wensheng offered to go.

sentences.zh: 廷臣佥言北寇强，本兵未可远出，乃推兵部右侍郎张海、都督同知缑谦二人。

translations.literal: Court officials unanimously said the northern bandits were strong and the minister of war could not go far; Zhang Hai, right vice minister of war, and Gou Qian, assistant commissioner-in-chief, were recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials unanimously argued that the northern raiders were strong and the minister of war could not leave the capital. Zhang Hai, right vice minister of war, and Gou Qian, assistant commissioner-in-chief, were recommended instead.

sentences.zh: 帝赐敕指授二人，而二人皆庸才，但遣土鲁番人归谕其主，令献还侵地，驻甘州待之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted edicts instructing the two men, but both were mediocre talents; they only sent Turpan people back to instruct their lord to return the seized territory and stationed themselves at Ganzhou to wait.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted edicts instructing the two men, but both proved mediocre. They merely sent Turpan envoys back to instruct their lord to return the seized territory and stationed themselves at Ganzhou to wait.

sentences.zh: 明年，阿黑麻遣使叩关求贡，诡言愿还陕巴及哈密，乞朝廷亦还其使者。

translations.literal: The following year Aheima sent envoys to knock at the pass requesting tribute, falsely claiming willingness to return Shanba and Hami and begging that the court also return his envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Aheima sent envoys to the frontier pass requesting tribute, falsely claiming willingness to return Shanba and Hami and begging that the court also release his envoys.

sentences.zh: 海等以闻，请再降敕宣谕。

translations.literal: Zhang Hai and the others reported this and requested that another edict be issued to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hai and his colleagues reported this and requested that another edict be issued.

sentences.zh: 廷议言，先已降敕，今若再降，有伤国体，宜令海等自遣人往谕。

translations.literal: Court discussion said an edict had already been issued; if another were issued now it would harm the dignity of the state; Zhang Hai and the others should be ordered to send their own people to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion noted that an edict had already been issued; to issue another would harm the dignity of the state. Zhang Hai and his colleagues should be ordered to send their own envoys.

sentences.zh: 不从命，则仍留前使，且尽驱新使出关，永不许贡，仍与守臣檄罕东、赤斤诸部兵，直捣哈密，袭斩牙兰。

translations.literal: If they did not obey, the previous envoys should still be detained, all new envoys driven out of the pass, tribute permanently forbidden, and border officials ordered to mobilize Handong, Chijin, and other tribal troops to strike straight at Hami and assassinate Yalan.
translations.idiomatic: If they did not obey, the previous envoys should remain detained, all new envoys should be driven from the pass, tribute permanently forbidden, and border officials ordered to mobilize Handong, Chijin, and other tribal troops to strike Hami and assassinate Yalan.

sentences.zh: 如无机可乘，则封嘉峪关，毋纳其使。

translations.literal: If no opportunity presented itself, Jiayu Pass should be closed and their envoys not admitted.
translations.idiomatic: If no opportunity presented itself, Jiayu Pass should be closed and their envoys refused entry.

sentences.zh: 陕巴虽封王，其还与否，于中国无损益，宜别择贤者代之。

translations.literal: Although Shanba had been enfeoffed as king, whether he returned or not was of no gain or loss to China; another worthy person should be chosen to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Although Shanba had been enfeoffed as king, whether he returned or not was of no gain or loss to China. Another worthy person should be chosen to replace him.

sentences.zh: 帝以陕巴既与中国无损益，则哈密城池已破，如献还，当若何处之。

translations.literal: The emperor said that since Shanba was of no gain or loss to China, and Hami's city walls were already broken, if it were returned, where should it be placed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked: if Shanba was of no gain or loss to China, and Hami's walls were already in ruins, where would the territory be placed if it were returned?

sentences.zh: 廷臣复言陕巴乃安定王千奔之侄，忠顺王之孙，向之封王，欲令镇抚一方尔。

translations.literal: Court officials again said Shanba was nephew of the Prince of Anding's Qianben and grandson of the King of Loyalty and Obedience; the earlier enfeoffment as king was merely to have him pacify and govern a region.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials replied that Shanba was nephew of the Prince of Anding's Qianben and grandson of the King of Loyalty and Obedience. The earlier enfeoffment had merely been intended to have him pacify and govern the region.

sentences.zh: 今被虏，孱弱可知，即使复还，势难复立。

translations.literal: Now captured, his weakness is evident; even if he were recovered, it would be difficult for him to be reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: Now captured, his weakness was evident. Even if recovered, he would be hard put to reestablish himself.

sentences.zh: 宜革其王爵，居之甘州，犒赉安定王，谕以不复立之故。

translations.literal: His royal title should be revoked, he should be settled at Ganzhou, the Prince of Anding should be rewarded, and the reason for not reestablishing him should be explained.
translations.idiomatic: His royal title should be revoked and he should be settled at Ganzhou. The Prince of Anding should be rewarded and told why he would not be reestablished.

sentences.zh: 令都督奄克孛剌总理哈密事，与回回都督写亦虎仙，哈剌灰都督拜迭力迷失等分领三种番人以辅之。

translations.literal: The commissioner Yanke Bolie should be ordered to manage Hami affairs overall, together with the Huihui commissioner Xieyihuxian, the Khalaghui commissioner Baidielimishi, and others to command the three kinds of foreign tribes respectively to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Yanke Bolie should be ordered to manage Hami affairs overall, assisted by Huihui commissioner Xieyihuxian, Khalaghui commissioner Baidielimishi, and others commanding the three tribal groups respectively.

sentences.zh: 且修浚苦峪城堑，凡番人散处甘、凉者，令悉还其地，给以牛具口粮。

translations.literal: Moreover Kuyu city's moat should be repaired and dredged; all foreign tribes scattered in Gan and Liang should be ordered to return to their territories and given oxen, tools, and rations.
translations.idiomatic: Kuyu city's defenses should be repaired and strengthened. All foreign tribes scattered in Ganzhou and Liangzhou should be ordered to return to their territories and given oxen, tools, and rations.

sentences.zh: 若陕巴未还，不必索取，我不急陕巴，彼将自还也。

translations.literal: If Shanba has not returned, there is no need to demand him; if we do not urgently seek Shanba, they will return him of their own accord.
translations.idiomatic: If Shanba has not been returned, there is no need to demand him. If we do not press for his return, they will send him back of their own accord.

sentences.zh: 帝悉如其言，敕諭海等。

translations.literal: The emperor fully approved their words and issued edicts instructing Zhang Hai and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fully approved and issued edicts instructing Zhang Hai and his colleagues.

sentences.zh: 海等见敕书将弃陕巴，甚喜，即逐其贡使，闭嘉峪关，缮修苦峪城，令流寓番人归其地，拜疏还朝。

translations.literal: Zhang Hai and the others, seeing the edict would abandon Shanba, were greatly pleased; they immediately expelled the tribute envoys, closed Jiayu Pass, repaired Kuyu city, ordered displaced foreign tribes to return to their territories, and memorialized before returning to court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hai and his colleagues, delighted that the edict would abandon Shanba, immediately expelled the tribute envoys, closed Jiayu Pass, repaired Kuyu city, ordered displaced tribes to return to their territories, and memorialized before returning to court.

sentences.zh: 八年正月至京，言官交章劾其经略无功，并下吏贬秩，而哈密终不还。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year they reached the capital; censorial officials submitted memorials one after another impeaching them for achieving nothing in the campaign; they were handed over to judicial authorities and demoted in rank, and Hami was never recovered.
translations.idiomatic: They reached the capital in the first month of Hongzhi 8. Censorial officials submitted memorial after memorial impeaching them for achieving nothing. They were handed over to judicial authorities and demoted, and Hami was never recovered.

sentences.zh: 文升锐意谋兴复，用许进巡抚甘肃以图之。

translations.literal: Ma Wensheng was determined to plan recovery and appointed Xu Jin as grand coordinator of Gansu to pursue it.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wensheng remained determined to recover Hami and appointed Xu Jin grand coordinator of Gansu to pursue the goal.

sentences.zh: 进偕大将刘宁等潜师夜袭，牙兰逸去，斩其遗卒，抚降余众而还。

translations.literal: Xu Jin together with the great general Liu Ning and others secretly led troops in a night raid; Yalan escaped, his remaining soldiers were beheaded, the rest were pacified and surrendered, and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jin together with the great general Liu Ning and others led a secret night raid. Yalan escaped, his remaining soldiers were killed, the rest were pacified and surrendered, and the Ming forces withdrew.

sentences.zh: 自明初以来，官军无涉其地者，诸番始知畏，阿黑麻亦欲还陕巴。

translations.literal: Since the beginning of the Ming, government troops had not entered that territory; the various tribes then first knew fear, and Aheima also wished to return Shanba.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the Ming, government troops had not entered that territory. The various tribes then first learned fear, and Aheima also wished to return Shanba.

sentences.zh: 然哈密屡破，遗民入居者旦暮虞寇。

translations.literal: Yet Hami had been repeatedly broken; the remnant people who entered to dwell there feared bandits morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Hami had been repeatedly devastated, and the remnant people who returned lived in constant fear of attack.

sentences.zh: 阿黑麻果复来攻，固守不下，讫散去。

translations.literal: Aheima indeed came again to attack; they held firm and could not be taken, and in the end he dispersed and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Aheima did attack again, but the defenders held firm and he eventually withdrew.

sentences.zh: 诸人自以穷窘难守，尽焚室庐，走肃州求济。

translations.literal: The people themselves, finding destitution and difficulty in holding the place, burned all dwellings and fled to Suzhou seeking relief.
translations.idiomatic: Finding themselves destitute and unable to hold the city, the people burned their dwellings and fled to Suzhou seeking relief.

sentences.zh: 边臣以闻，诏赐牛具、谷种，并发流寓三种番人及哈密之寄居赤斤者，尽赴苦峪及瓜、沙州，俾自耕牧，以图兴复。

translations.literal: Border officials reported this; an edict granted oxen, tools, and seed grain, and also sent the three kinds of displaced foreign tribes and Hami people residing in Chijin, all to proceed to Kuyu and Guazhou and Shazhou, to farm and herd for themselves, planning recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Border officials reported this. An edict granted oxen, tools, and seed grain, and ordered the three displaced tribal groups and Hami people residing in Chijin all to proceed to Kuyu, Guazhou, and Shazhou to farm and herd for themselves, planning eventual recovery.

sentences.zh: 时哈密无王，奄克孛剌为之长。

translations.literal: At this time Hami had no king; Yanke Bolie was its chief.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Hami had no king; Yanke Bolie served as its chief.

sentences.zh: 十年遣其党写亦虎仙等来贡，给币帛五千酬其直，使臣犹久留，大肆咆烋。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he sent his followers Xieyihuxian and others with tribute; five thousand in coins and silks were given as payment for their goods; the envoys still lingered long and raged violently.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 10 he sent his followers Xieyihuxian and others with tribute. Five thousand strings in coins and silks were given as payment, yet the envoys lingered and raged violently.

sentences.zh: 礼官徐琼等极论其罪，乃驱之去。

translations.literal: The ritual official Xu Qiong and others argued their crimes at length; they were then driven away.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual official Xu Qiong and others argued their crimes at length, and they were driven away.

sentences.zh: 时诸番以朝廷闭关绝贡不得入，咸怨阿黑麻，阿黑麻悔，送还陕巴及哈密之众，乞通贡如故。

translations.literal: At this time the various tribes, because the court had closed the pass and cut off tribute so they could not enter, all resented Aheima; Aheima repented, returned Shanba and the people of Hami, and begged to restore tribute as before.
translations.idiomatic: The various tribes, barred from tribute by the closed pass, all resented Aheima. Aheima repented, returned Shanba and the people of Hami, and begged to restore tribute as before.

sentences.zh: 廷议谓无番文不可骤许，必令具文乃从其请。

translations.literal: Court discussion said that without a written document from the tribes it could not be suddenly granted; they must submit a written document before their request would be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion held that without a formal written submission from the tribes the request could not be granted at once—they must submit proper documentation first.

sentences.zh: 陕巴前议废，今使暂居甘州，俟众头目俱归心，然后修复哈密城堑，令复旧业。

translations.literal: Previously Shanba had been discussed for removal from office; now he was to reside temporarily at Ganzhou, wait until all the chieftains had pledged their loyalty, then repair Hami's walls and moats and let him resume his former position.
translations.idiomatic: Shanba had earlier been considered for dismissal; the court now ordered him to stay temporarily at Ganzhou until the various chieftains had been won over, after which Hami's fortifications would be restored and he would resume his former rule.

sentences.zh: 帝悉从之。

translations.literal: The emperor entirely approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 冬，起王越总制三边军务兼经理哈密。

translations.literal: In winter, Wang Yue was summoned to take overall command of military affairs on the three frontiers and concurrently manage Hami.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Wang Yue was appointed grand coordinator of military affairs on the three frontiers, with responsibility for Hami as well.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，越言哈密不可弃，陕巴亦不可废，宜仍其旧封，令先还哈密，量给修城、筑室之费，犒赐三种番人及赤斤、罕东、小列秃、乜克力诸部，以奖前劳，且责后效。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eleventh year, Yue said Hami must not be abandoned and Shanba must not be removed; they should retain their former enfeoffment, let him return to Hami first, allocate funds for repairing the city and building dwellings, and reward the three kinds of tribal peoples and the tribes of Chijin, Handong, Xiaolietu, and Mikeli to commend prior service and also demand future results.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eleventh year, Wang Yue argued that Hami must not be abandoned and Shanba must not be deposed. Their original titles should stand; Shanba should be sent back to Hami first, given sufficient funds to repair the city and build dwellings, and the three tribal peoples along with the Chijin, Handong, Xiaolietu, and Mikeli clans should be rewarded to honor past service and exact future loyalty.

sentences.zh: 帝亦报可。

translations.literal: The emperor also replied that it was acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this as well.

sentences.zh: 自是哈密复安，土鲁番亦修贡惟谨。

translations.literal: From this time Hami was again at peace, and Turpan also paid tribute with utmost care.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Hami regained stability, and Turpan resumed tributary relations with scrupulous deference.

sentences.zh: 奄克孛剌者，罕慎弟也，与陕巴不相能。

translations.literal: Yanke Boluo was Hanshen's younger brother; he and Shanba could not get along.
