translations.idiomatic: Yanke Boluo was the younger brother of Hanshen and was on bad terms with Shanba.

sentences.zh: 当事患之，令陕巴娶罕慎女，与之结好。

translations.literal: Those in charge worried about this and had Shanba marry Hanshen's daughter to form a bond of friendship with him.
translations.idiomatic: Officials concerned by the rift arranged for Shanba to marry Hanshen's daughter in hopes of mending relations.

sentences.zh: 陕巴嗜酒掊克，失众心，部下阿孛剌等咸怨。

translations.literal: Shanba loved wine and extorted from others, losing the hearts of the people; his subordinates such as Aboluo all resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Shanba was fond of drinking and preyed on his people, alienating them; subordinates such as Aboluo grew resentful.

sentences.zh: 十七年春，阴构阿黑麻迎其幼子真帖木儿主哈密。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventeenth year, they secretly colluded with Aheima to welcome his young son Zhentiemu'er to rule Hami.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventeenth year, they secretly colluded with Aheima to install his young son Zhentiemu'er as ruler of Hami.

sentences.zh: 陕巴惧，挈家走苦峪。

translations.literal: Shanba was afraid and fled with his family to Kuyu.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Shanba fled with his family to Kuyu.

sentences.zh: 奄克孛剌与写亦虎仙在肃州，边臣以二人为番众所服，令还辅陕巴，与百户董杰偕行。

translations.literal: Yanke Boluo and Xieyihuxian were in Suzhou; frontier officials, considering that the two men were respected by the tribal peoples, ordered them to return to assist Shanba, and they went together with the company commander Dong Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Yanke Boluo and Xieyihuxian were at Suzhou. Because frontier officials knew both commanded the tribes' respect, they were sent back to support Shanba, traveling together with Company Commander Dong Jie.

sentences.zh: 杰有胆略。

translations.literal: Jie had courage and resourcefulness.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Jie was bold and capable.

sentences.zh: 既抵哈密，阿孛剌与其党五人约夜以兵来劫。

translations.literal: After arriving at Hami, Aboluo and five of his accomplices agreed to come by night with troops to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Once they reached Hami, Aboluo and five accomplices plotted a night attack.

sentences.zh: 杰知之，与奄克孛剌等谋，召阿孛剌等计事，立斩之，其下遂不敢叛。

translations.literal: Jie learned of this; he conspired with Yanke Boluo and the others, summoned Aboluo and the others to discuss affairs, and immediately beheaded them; their followers then dared not rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Jie learned of the plot and, with Yanke Boluo and the others, summoned Aboluo and his conspirators on the pretext of consultation, then executed them on the spot. Their followers no longer dared rebel.

sentences.zh: 乃令陕巴还哈密，真帖木儿还土鲁番。

translations.literal: They then ordered Shanba to return to Hami and Zhentiemu'er to return to Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: Shanba was restored to Hami and Zhentiemu'er was sent back to Turpan.

sentences.zh: 真帖木儿年十三，其母即罕慎女也，闻父已死，兄满速儿嗣为速檀与诸弟相仇杀，惧不敢归，愿倚奄克孛剌，曰：“吾外祖也。”

translations.literal: Zhentiemu'er was thirteen years old; his mother was Hanshen's daughter. Hearing that his father was already dead and his elder brother Mansuer had succeeded as sultan and was mutually killing with his brothers, he feared and dared not return, wishing to rely on Yanke Boluo, saying: "He is my maternal grandfather."
translations.idiomatic: Zhentiemu'er was thirteen. His mother was Hanshen's daughter. When he learned his father was dead and his elder brother Mansuer had become sultan and was fighting his brothers, he was afraid to return home. He asked to stay with Yanke Boluo, saying, "He is my maternal grandfather."

sentences.zh: 边臣虑与陕巴隙，居之甘州。

translations.literal: Frontier officials, fearing friction with Shanba, had him reside at Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials, worried this would strain relations with Shanba, settled him at Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年冬，陕巴卒，其子拜牙即自称速檀，命封为忠顺王。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighteenth year, Shanba died; his son Baiyaji declared himself sultan and was commanded to be enfeoffed as Prince of Loyal Submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eighteenth year Shanba died. His son Baiyaji proclaimed himself sultan and was invested as Prince of Loyal Submission.

sentences.zh: 正德三年，写亦虎仙入贡，不与通事偕行，自携边臣文牒投进。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengde, Xieyihuxian came to pay tribute without traveling together with an interpreter; he himself carried the frontier officials' documents and submitted them.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 3, Xieyihuxian arrived to pay tribute without an accompanying interpreter, presenting frontier officials' documents on his own.

sentences.zh: 大通事王永怒，疏请究治，写酋亦奏永需求。

translations.literal: Senior Interpreter Wang Yong was angry and memorialized requesting investigation and punishment; the Xie chieftain also memorialized that Yong made demands.
translations.idiomatic: Senior Interpreter Wang Yong was incensed and memorialized for an inquiry; the Xie chieftain in turn accused Yong of extortion.

sentences.zh: 永供奉豹房，恃宠恣横。

translations.literal: Yong served in the Leopard Quarter and, relying on imperial favor, acted with reckless arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yong served in the Leopard Quarter and abused the emperor's favor with outrageous impunity.

sentences.zh: 诏勿究治，两戒谕之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that there be no investigation or punishment, and both were admonished.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered that no inquiry proceed and issued warnings to both men.

sentences.zh: 写酋自是益轻朝廷，潜怀异志。

translations.literal: From this the Xie chieftain increasingly looked down on the court and secretly harbored divergent intentions.
translations.idiomatic: After this the Xie chieftain grew bolder in his contempt for the court and began secretly scheming against it.

sentences.zh: 初，拜牙即嗣职，满速儿与通和，且遣使求真帖木儿，边臣言与之便。

translations.literal: Initially, when Baiyaji succeeded to his position, Mansuer made peace with him and also sent envoys requesting Zhentiemu'er; frontier officials said it would be convenient to give him over.
translations.idiomatic: When Baiyaji first took office, Mansuer reconciled with him and sent envoys asking for the return of Zhentiemu'er; frontier officials argued that returning the boy would be expedient.

sentences.zh: 枢臣谓土鲁番稔恶久，今见我扶植哈密，声势渐张，乃卑词求贡，以还弟为名。

translations.literal: Central ministers said Turpan had long been steeped in evil; now seeing us support Hami and its power gradually expanding, it uses humble words to seek tribute, using the return of a younger brother as a pretext.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers at court observed that Turpan had long been hostile. Seeing Ming support for Hami growing, it now sues for tributary access in humble terms, using the request to recover a brother as cover.

sentences.zh: 我留其弟，正合古人质其亲爱之意，不可遽遣。

translations.literal: Our keeping his younger brother precisely accorded with the ancients' idea of holding beloved ones as hostages; he must not be sent back hastily.
translations.idiomatic: Holding his brother hostage was exactly in the spirit of the ancient practice of guaranteeing loyalty through hostages; he should not be released prematurely.

sentences.zh: 帝从之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 六年始命写亦虎仙偕都督满哈剌三送之西还，至哈密，奄克孛剌欲止之，二人不可。

translations.literal: Only in the sixth year was Xieyihuxian ordered, together with Commander-in-chief Manhalasan, to escort him westward back; when they reached Hami, Yanke Boluo wanted to stop them, but the two would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Not until the sixth year was Xieyihuxian sent, together with Commander Manhalasan, to escort the boy west. At Hami, Yanke Boluo tried to intervene, but the two men refused to stop.

sentences.zh: 护至土鲁番，遂以国情输满速儿，且诱拜牙即叛。

translations.literal: After escorting him to Turpan, he then reported the state's situation to Mansuer and also incited Baiyaji to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Once they reached Turpan, Xieyihuxian briefed Mansuer on conditions at court and urged Baiyaji to defect.

sentences.zh: 拜牙即素昏愚，性又淫暴，心怵属部害已，而满速儿又甘言诱之，即欲偕奄克孛剌同往，不从，奔肃州。

translations.literal: Baiyaji had always been dull-witted; his nature was also lecherous and cruel. His heart feared that his subordinate tribes would harm him, and Mansuer also used sweet words to entice him. He then wished to go together with Yanke Boluo, but when Yanke Boluo would not agree, he fled to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Baiyaji was naturally dim and credulous, lecherous and brutal besides. Fearful that his own tribes might turn on him, and swayed by Mansuer's flattery, he wanted Yanke Boluo to accompany him but, when refused, fled to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年秋，拜牙即弃城叛入土鲁番。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year, Baiyaji abandoned the city and rebelled, entering Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighth year Baiyaji abandoned his city and defected to Turpan.

sentences.zh: 满速儿遣火者他只丁据哈密，又遣火者马黑木赴甘肃言拜牙即不能守国，满速儿遣将代守，乞犒赐。

translations.literal: Mansuer sent Khwaja Taziding to hold Hami, and also sent Khwaja Maheimu to Gansu saying Baiyaji could not guard the state, that Mansuer had sent a general to guard in his place, and requesting rewards and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Mansuer sent Khwaja Taziding to seize Hami and dispatched Khwaja Maheimu to Gansu with word that Baiyaji could not hold the realm, that he had sent a general to occupy it in his stead, and a request for rewards.

sentences.zh: 九年四月，事闻，命都御史彭泽往经略。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the ninth year, when the matter was reported, Censor-in-chief Peng Ze was ordered to go and manage the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When news reached court in the fourth month of the ninth year, Grand Coordinator Peng Ze was dispatched to manage the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 泽未至，贼遣兵分掠苦峪、沙州，声言予我金币万，即归城印。

translations.literal: Before Ze arrived, the bandits sent troops to plunder separately at Kuyu and Shazhou, declaring that if given ten thousand in gold and coins, they would return the city and seal.
translations.idiomatic: Before Peng Ze arrived, the enemy raided Kuyu and Shazhou and demanded ten thousand in gold and cash in exchange for the city and its seal.

sentences.zh: 泽抵甘州，谓番人嗜利，可因而款也。

translations.literal: Ze reached Ganzhou and said the tribal peoples were greedy for profit; one could thereby sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Ganzhou, Peng Ze reasoned that the tribes were greedy and could be pacified through negotiation.

sentences.zh: 遣通事马骥谕令还侵地及王，当予重赏。

translations.literal: He sent Interpreter Ma Ji to instruct them to return the invaded lands and the prince, promising a heavy reward.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Interpreter Ma Ji to demand the return of seized territory and the loyal prince, promising generous rewards.

sentences.zh: 满速儿伪许之，泽即畀币帛二千及白金酒器一具。

translations.literal: Mansuer falsely agreed; Ze immediately gave two thousand in silks and cloth and one set of white-gold wine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Mansuer feigned agreement, and Peng Ze at once paid out two thousand bolts of silk and cloth and a white-gold wine set.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月，拜疏言：“臣遣通事往宣国威，要以重赏，其酋悔过效顺，即以金印及哈密城付之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year, he memorialized saying: "Your subject sent an interpreter to proclaim the state's majesty and demanded heavy rewards; the chieftain repented his errors and submitted, and the gold seal and Hami city were delivered to him."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year Peng Ze memorialized: "I sent an interpreter to proclaim imperial authority and promised rich rewards. The chieftain repented and submitted, and the gold seal and city of Hami were returned."

sentences.zh: 满哈剌三、写亦虎仙二人召还他只丁，并还所夺赤斤卫印。

translations.literal: Manhalasan and Xieyihuxian, the two men, recalled Taziding and also returned the seized seal of the Chijin Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Manhalasan and Xieyihuxian also recalled Taziding and restored the stolen seal of the Chijin Guard.

sentences.zh: 惟忠顺王在他所，未还。

translations.literal: Only the Prince of Loyal Submission was at another place and had not been returned.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Prince of Loyal Submission remained elsewhere and had not been sent back.

sentences.zh: 请录效劳人役功，赐臣骸骨归田里。”

translations.literal: He requested recording the services of those who had exerted themselves and granting your subject's bones to return to fields and village.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the merits of those who had served be recorded and that he be permitted to retire home.

sentences.zh: 帝即令还朝。

translations.literal: The emperor immediately ordered him to return to court.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at once summoned him back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 忠顺王迄不返，他只丁亦不肯退，复要重赏，始以城来归。

translations.literal: The Prince of Loyal Submission to the end did not return; Taziding also would not withdraw, again demanding heavy rewards before bringing the city back in submission.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Loyal Submission never came back. Taziding refused to withdraw and again demanded rich rewards before surrendering the city.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，甘肃巡抚李昆上言：“得满速儿牒，谓拜牙即不可复位，即还故土，已失人心，乞别立安定王千奔后裔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year, Gansu Grand Coordinator Li Kun memorialized saying: "I received Mansuer's dispatch, stating that Baiyaji cannot be restored to his position, that even if he returns to his old territory he has already lost people's hearts, and requesting that a descendant of Prince Anding Qianben be established separately."
translations.idiomatic: The following May, Gansu Grand Coordinator Li Kun reported: "Mansuer writes that Baiyaji cannot be restored—that even if he returned he has lost all support—and asks that a descendant of Prince Anding Qianben be installed instead."

sentences.zh: 此言良然。

translations.literal: These words were indeed so.
translations.idiomatic: This argument had merit.

sentences.zh: 如必欲其复国，乞敕满速儿兄弟送还，仍厚赐缯帛，冀其效顺。”

translations.literal: If you must want him to recover his state, I beg you issue an edict ordering Mansuer and his brothers to send him back, and still lavish silks and cloth generously, hoping they will submit in effect.
translations.idiomatic: If the court insists on restoring him, it should order Mansuer and his brothers to send him back and reward them generously in hopes of winning their cooperation.

sentences.zh: 廷议：“经略西陲已逾三载，而忠顺迄无还期，宜兴师绝贡，不可遂其要求，损我威重。

translations.literal: Court deliberation: "Managing the western frontier has already exceeded three years, yet the Prince of Loyal Submission has to the end no date of return; troops should be raised and tribute cut off; their demands must not be granted, damaging our prestige and weight."
translations.idiomatic: The court debated: "The western frontier has been under management for more than three years, yet the Prince of Loyal Submission shows no sign of returning. We should mobilize troops and cut off tribute rather than yield to their demands and damage imperial prestige."

sentences.zh: 但城印归，国体具在，宜敕责满速儿背负国恩，求取无厌。

translations.literal: But with the city and seal returned, the state's form is fully present; Mansuer should be edict-rebuked for betraying the state's grace and seeking without satiety.
translations.idiomatic: With the city and seal restored, the form of our authority remains intact. Mansuer should be rebuked for betraying imperial grace and making insatiable demands.

sentences.zh: 仍量赐其兄弟，令其速归忠顺。

translations.literal: Still grant his brothers in measured amount and order them speedily to return the Prince of Loyal Submission.
translations.idiomatic: A measured gift should still be sent to his brothers, with orders to return the loyal prince at once.

sentences.zh: 不从，则闭关绝贡，严兵为备。”

translations.literal: If they do not follow, then close the passes and cut off tribute, strictly preparing troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: If they refuse, close the border, halt tribute, and prepare the army for defense.

sentences.zh: 从之。

translations.literal: This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 初，写亦虎仙与满速儿深相结，故首倡逆谋。

translations.literal: Initially, Xieyihuxian and Mansuer were deeply allied, and therefore he first advocated the rebellious scheme.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyihuxian had been closely allied with Mansuer and had been the first to instigate rebellion.

sentences.zh: 已而有隙，满速儿欲杀之，大惧，求他只丁为解，许赂币千五百匹，期至肃州畀之，且啖之入寇，曰肃州可得也。

translations.literal: Afterwards there was a rift; Mansuer wanted to kill him. Greatly afraid, he asked Taziding to mediate, promising a bribe of one thousand five hundred bolts of cloth, with a date to deliver them at Suzhou, and also enticed him to invade, saying Suzhou could be taken.
translations.idiomatic: A rift later opened, and when Mansuer sought his life Xieyihuxian was terrified. He asked Taziding to intercede, promising fifteen hundred bolts of cloth to be delivered at Suzhou, and baited him with an invasion plan, claiming Suzhou could be seized.

sentences.zh: 满速儿喜，令与其婿马黑木俱入贡，以觇虚实，且徵其赂。

translations.literal: Mansuer was pleased and ordered him and his son-in-law Maheimu together to come pay tribute, to spy out strengths and weaknesses, and also collect the bribe.
translations.idiomatic: Delighted, Mansuer sent him and his son-in-law Maheimu to pay tribute, both to probe Ming defenses and collect the promised bribe.

sentences.zh: 边臣以同来火者撒者儿，乃火者他只丁弟，惧为变，并其党虎都写亦羁之甘州，而督写亦虎仙出关，惧不肯去。

translations.literal: Frontier officials, because the accompanying Khwaja Sazhe'er was Khwaja Taziding's younger brother, feared trouble and detained him together with his accomplice Huduxieye at Ganzhou, and supervised Xieyihuxian to leave the pass; afraid, he refused to go.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials, fearing trouble when they learned that the accompanying Khwaja Sazhe'er was Taziding's brother, detained him and his accomplice Huduxieye at Ganzhou and ordered Xieyihuxian to leave the frontier—but he was too afraid to go.

sentences.zh: 他只丁闻其弟被拘，怒，复又夺哈密城，请满速儿移居之，分兵胁据沙州，拥众入寇，至兔儿壩，游击芮宁与参将蒋存礼，都指挥黄荣、王琮各率兵往御。

translations.literal: Taziding heard his younger brother was detained, grew angry, again seized Hami city, invited Mansuer to move there, divided troops to coerce and hold Shazhou, gathered crowds to invade, reaching Tu'erba; Mobile Corps Commander Rui Ning together with Assistant General Jiang Cunli, and Regional Commanders Huang Rong and Wang Cong each led troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: When Taziding learned his brother had been detained, he flew into a rage, seized Hami again, and invited Mansuer to move his seat there. He split his force to threaten Shazhou and led a large raid as far as Tu'erba. Mobile Corps Commander Rui Ning, Assistant General Jiang Cunli, and Regional Commanders Huang Rong and Wang Cong each marched out to meet them.

sentences.zh: 宁先抵沙子壩，遇贼。

translations.literal: Ning first reached Shaziba and encountered the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Ning reached Shaziba first and clashed with the enemy.

sentences.zh: 贼悉众围宁，而分兵缀诸将，宁所部七百人皆战没。

translations.literal: The bandits gathered all their forces to surround Ning, while dividing troops to delay the other generals; all seven hundred of Ning's command were killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy concentrated their force against Rui Ning while detachments tied down the other commanders. All seven hundred of his men were killed.

sentences.zh: 贼薄肃州城，索所许币。

translations.literal: The bandits pressed close to Suzhou city and demanded the promised cloth payment.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders pressed Suzhou and demanded the promised bribe.

sentences.zh: 副使陈九畴固守，且先绝其内应，贼知事泄，虑援兵至，大掠而去。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Chen Jiuchi firmly defended, and first cut off their internal collaborators; the bandits knew the matter was exposed, feared relief troops arriving, and after great plundering departed.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Chen Jiuchi held firm and preemptively severed their internal contacts. Once the plot was exposed, the raiders, fearing reinforcements, pillaged heavily and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月，羽书闻，廷议复命彭泽总制军务，偕中官张永、都督郤永率师西征。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year, urgent dispatches were reported; court deliberation again ordered Peng Ze to take overall command of military affairs, together with eunuch Zhang Yong and Commander-in-chief Xi Yong to lead troops on a western expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twelfth year, urgent reports reached the capital. The court again appointed Peng Ze to overall command, with Eunuch Zhang Yong and Commander Xi Yong, for a western campaign.

sentences.zh: 贼还至瓜州，副总兵郑廉合奄克孛剌兵击败之，斩七十九级。

translations.literal: The bandits returned to Guazhou; Vice Commander-in-chief Zheng Lian combined with Yanke Boluo's troops and defeated them, beheading seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: On their withdrawal to Guazhou, Vice Commander Zheng Lian, joining Yanke Boluo's forces, routed them and took seventy-nine heads.

sentences.zh: 贼乃遁去，又与瓦剌相攻，力不敌，移书求款，泽等乃罢行。

translations.literal: The bandits then fled away, and also fought with the Oirats; their strength could not match, and they sent a letter suing for peace; Ze and the others then halted their march.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy fled, then clashed with the Oirats and, overmatched, sued for peace by letter. Peng Ze and his column turned back.

sentences.zh: 先是，写亦虎仙与子米儿马黑木、婿火者马黑木及其党失拜烟答俱以内应系狱，失拜烟答被捶死。

translations.literal: Earlier, Xieyihuxian together with his son Mi'ermaheimu, son-in-law Khwaja Maheimu, and his accomplice Shibaiyanda were all imprisoned for internal collaboration; Shibaiyanda was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xieyihuxian, his son Mi'ermaheimu, his son-in-law Khwaja Maheimu, and their accomplice Shibaiyanda had been jailed as collaborators. Shibaiyanda was beaten to death in custody.

sentences.zh: 及事平，械写亦虎仙赴京，下刑部狱，其子仍系甘州。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Xieyihuxian was transported in cuffs to the capital and placed in the Ministry of Justice prison; his son remained detained at Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the crisis subsided Xieyihuxian was shackled and sent to the capital for imprisonment in the Ministry of Justice; his son remained held at Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 失拜烟答子米儿马黑麻者，写亦虎仙侄婿也，以入贡在京，探知王琼欲倾彭泽，突入长安门讼父冤，下锦衣狱。

translations.literal: Shibaiyanda's son Mi'ermaheima was Xieyihuxian's nephew-by-marriage; he was at the capital on tribute mission, learned that Wang Qiong wished to topple Peng Ze, suddenly entered Chang'an Gate to sue for his father's injustice, and was placed in the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.
translations.idiomatic: Shibaiyanda's son Mi'ermaheima, who was married to Xieyihuxian's nephew, was in the capital on tribute business. Learning that Wang Qiong was moving against Peng Ze, he burst through Chang'an Gate to plead his father's innocence and was thrown into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.

sentences.zh: 会兵部、法司请行甘肃讯报，琼欲因此兴大狱，奏遣科道二人往勘。

translations.literal: When the Ministry of War and the legal offices requested sending to Gansu for inquiry and report, Qiong wished thereby to raise a major case and memorialized dispatching two supervisory officials to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ministry of War and the judiciary asked that the case be heard in Gansu, Wang Qiong sought to broaden it into a major prosecution and memorialized to send two supervisory censors to investigate.

sentences.zh: 明年，勘至，于泽无所坐。

translations.literal: The next year the investigation arrived; Ze was found guilty of nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the investigators reported back: Peng Ze was cleared of wrongdoing.

sentences.zh: 琼怒，劾泽欺罔辱国，斥为民。

translations.literal: Qiong was angry and impeached Ze for deceit and disgrace to the state, dismissing him to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Wang Qiong impeached Peng Ze for deceiving the throne and disgracing the realm and had him reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 坐昆、九畴激变，逮下吏，并获重谴。

translations.literal: Kun and Jiuchi were convicted of inciting the uprising, seized and handed to officials, and also received severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kun and Chen Jiuchi were charged with provoking the crisis, arrested, and severely punished.

sentences.zh: 明年，写亦虎仙亦减死，遂夤缘钱宁，与其婿得侍帝左右。

translations.literal: The next year, Xieyihuxian also had his death sentence reduced, then by connection with Qian Ning, he and his son-in-law obtained service at the emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Xieyihuxian's death sentence was commuted. Through Qian Ning's patronage he and his son-in-law gained access to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝悦之，赐国姓，授锦衣指挥，扈驾南征。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased with them, granted the state surname, appointed them Embroidered Uniform Guard commanders, and they escorted the emperor on the southern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took a liking to them, bestowed the imperial surname, appointed them commanders in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and they accompanied him on campaign in the south.

sentences.zh: 满速儿犯边后，屡求通贡，不得。

translations.literal: After Mansuer violated the border, he repeatedly sought to restore tribute but could not obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: After his border raids Mansuer repeatedly petitioned to resume tribute but was refused.

sentences.zh: 十五年归先所掠将卒及忠顺王家属，复求贡。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he returned the previously seized officers, soldiers, and the Prince of Loyal Submission's family members, and again sought tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he returned captured Ming officers and soldiers along with the loyal prince's family and again petitioned for tributary access.

sentences.zh: 廷议许之，而王迄不还。

translations.literal: Court deliberation permitted it, but the prince to the end did not return.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed, but the prince never returned.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史潘仿力言贡不当许，不听。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Pan Fang strongly said tribute should not be permitted; this was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Pan Fang argued forcefully against resuming tribute, but his advice was ignored.

sentences.zh: 明年，世宗嗣位，杨廷和以写亦虎仙稔中国情实，归必为边患，于遗诏中数其罪，并其子婿伏诛，而用陈九畴为甘肃巡抚。

translations.literal: The next year the Shizong succeeded; Yang Tinghe, considering that Xieyihuxian was thoroughly versed in China's real conditions and that if he returned he would surely be a frontier calamity, counted his crimes in the accession edict, and together with his son and son-in-law he was executed, while Chen Jiuchi was employed as Gansu Grand Coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when the Jiajing emperor succeeded, Yang Tinghe—believing that Xieyihuxian knew too much about Ming affairs and would become a border menace if spared—listed his crimes in the succession edict. Xieyihuxian and his son and son-in-law were executed, and Chen Jiuchi was appointed Gansu Grand Coordinator.

sentences.zh: 时满速儿比岁来贡，朝廷待之若故，亦不复问忠顺王事。

translations.literal: At that time Mansuer came to pay tribute year by year; the court treated him as before and also no longer inquired about the Prince of Loyal Submission affair.
translations.idiomatic: Mansuer continued sending tribute yearly, and the court received him as before, no longer pressing the question of the loyal prince.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年秋，拥二万骑围肃州，分兵犯甘州。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year of Jiajing, he gathered twenty thousand horsemen to besiege Suzhou and divided troops to attack Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Jiajing 3 he led twenty thousand cavalry to besiege Suzhou while detachments struck at Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 九畴及总兵官姜奭等力战败之，斩他只丁，贼乃却去。

translations.literal: Jiuchi and Commander-in-chief Jiang Yi and others exerted force and defeated them, beheading Taziding; the bandits then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jiuchi and Commander Jiang Yi fought hard, defeated the invaders, and killed Taziding, after which the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 事闻，命兵部尚书金献民西讨，抵兰州，贼已久退，乃引还。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Minister of War Jin Xianmin was ordered on a western punitive expedition; he reached Lanzhou, the bandits had long retreated, and he then led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: On receiving word of the victory, the court dispatched Minister of War Jin Xianmin westward. He reached Lanzhou after the enemy had already fled and turned back.

sentences.zh: 九畴因力言贼不可抚，乞闭关绝贡，专固边防，可之。

translations.literal: Jiuchi therefore strongly said the bandits could not be conciliated, begged to close the passes and cut off tribute, and focus solely on strengthening frontier defense; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jiuchi urged that the enemy could not be conciliated and petitioned to close the border and halt tribute in favor of hard frontier defense. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 明年秋，贼复犯肃州，分兵围参将云冒，而以大众抵南山。

translations.literal: The next autumn, the bandits again attacked Suzhou, divided troops to surround Assistant General Yun Mao, and with the main force reached Nanshan.
translations.idiomatic: The following autumn the enemy again raided Suzhou, pinning down Assistant General Yun Mao with a detachment while the main body pushed toward Nanshan.

sentences.zh: 九畴时已解职，他将援兵至，贼始遁。

translations.literal: Jiuchi at that time had already been relieved of office; other generals' relief troops arrived, and the bandits then fled.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jiuchi had by then left office, but other generals' reinforcements arrived and the raiders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 当是时，番屡犯边城，当局者无能振国威，为边疆复仇雪耻，而一二新进用事者反借以修怨。

translations.literal: At this time the tribes repeatedly violated the border cities; those in authority were unable to revive the state's majesty and avenge and wipe away shame for the frontier, while one or two newly risen men in power instead used this to settle old scores.
translations.idiomatic: In those years the tribes raided repeatedly, yet those in power could neither restore imperial prestige nor avenge the frontier. Instead, a handful of newly risen officials turned the crisis into a weapon for personal vendettas.

sentences.zh: 由是，封疆之狱起。

translations.literal: From this, borderland cases arose.
translations.idiomatic: Thus began the great border-affairs prosecutions.

sentences.zh: 百户王邦奇者，素憾杨廷和、彭泽，六年春，上言：“今哈密失国，番贼内侵，由泽赂番求和，廷和论杀写亦虎仙所致。

translations.literal: Company Commander Wang Bangqi had long resented Yang Tinghe and Peng Ze; in the spring of the sixth year he memorialized saying: "Now Hami has lost its state, and tribal bandits invade inward, caused by Ze bribing the tribes to seek peace and Tinghe's advocacy for executing Xieyihuxian."
translations.idiomatic: Company Commander Wang Bangqi, who had long hated Yang Tinghe and Peng Ze, memorialized in the spring of the sixth year: "Hami's fall and the tribal incursions stem from Peng Ze's bribes for peace and Yang Tinghe's role in executing Xieyihuxian."

sentences.zh: 诛此两人，庶哈密可复，边境无虞。”

translations.literal: Execute these two men, and perhaps Hami can be recovered and the border will have no worries.
translations.idiomatic: Execute these two men, and Hami may yet be recovered and the frontier secured.

sentences.zh: 桂萼、张璁辈欲藉此兴大狱，斥廷和、泽为民，尽置其子弟亲党于理，有自杀者。

translations.literal: Gui E, Zhang Cong, and their faction wished to use this to raise a major case, dismissed Tinghe and Ze to commoner status, and entirely placed their sons, brothers, and associates before the law; some committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Gui E, Zhang Cong, and their allies seized on this to launch a sweeping prosecution. Yang Tinghe and Peng Ze were stripped of rank, and their families and associates were put on trial—some took their own lives.

sentences.zh: 复遣给事、锦衣官往按。

translations.literal: They again dispatched supervising secretaries and Embroidered Uniform Guard officials to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory censors and Embroidered Uniform Guard officers were again sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 番酋牙兰言非敢获罪天朝，所以犯边，由冤杀写亦虎仙、失拜烟答二人故。

translations.literal: The tribal chieftain Yalan said he did not dare to have offended the Celestial Dynasty; the reason for violating the border was because Xieyihuxian and Shibaiyanda, two men, were unjustly killed.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal chieftain Yalan declared that he had not wished to offend the Ming court; his raids were provoked by the unjust executions of Xieyihuxian and Shibaiyanda.

sentences.zh: 今愿献还城印赎前罪。

translations.literal: Now he wishes to present and return the city and seal to redeem previous crimes.
translations.idiomatic: He now offered to return the city and seal in atonement.

sentences.zh: 事下兵部，尚书王时中等言：“番酋乞贡数四，先已下总制尚书王宪，因其贡使镌责。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the Ministry of War; Minister Wang Shizhong and others said: "The tribal chieftain has begged for tribute four times; earlier it was already sent down to Grand Coordinator Minister Wang Xian, who through his tribute envoy engraved a rebuke."
translations.idiomatic: The matter went to the Ministry of War. Minister Wang Shizhong argued: "The chieftain has petitioned for tribute four times. Grand Coordinator Wang Xian already rebuked him through his envoys."

sentences.zh: 所请当不妄，第其词出牙兰，非真求贡之文，或诈以款我。

translations.literal: What was requested should not be false, but only that the words came from Yalan, not a genuine petition for tribute; perhaps deceiving to conciliate us.
translations.idiomatic: His request may be sincere, but the message came from Yalan rather than a formal tribute petition—possibly a ruse to appease us.

sentences.zh: 若果悔罪，必先归城印及所掠人畜，械送首恶，稽首关门，方可听许。”

translations.literal: If he truly repents his crimes, he must first return the city and seal and the seized people and livestock, send the chief criminals in fetters, and kowtow at the pass gate—only then may he be permitted to be heard and allowed.
translations.idiomatic: If he truly repents, he must first restore the city and seal, return seized people and livestock, deliver the ringleaders in chains, and prostrate himself at the border gate. Only then should tribute be considered.

sentences.zh: 帝纳之。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 萼以前狱未竟，必欲重兴大狱，请留质牙兰，遣译者谕其主还侵地。

translations.literal: E, because the previous cases were not yet finished, necessarily wished to again raise a major case, requested detaining Yalan as a hostage, and dispatching a translator to instruct his lord to return the invaded lands.
translations.idiomatic: Gui E, determined to reopen prosecutions from the earlier affair, asked that Yalan be held as a hostage while an interpreter was sent to demand the return of seized territory.

sentences.zh: 而与礼、兵二部尚书方献夫、王时中等协议，为挑激之词，言番人上书者四辈，皆委咎前吏，虽词多诋饰，亦事发有因。

translations.literal: And together with the Ministers of Rites and War, Fang Xianfu and Wang Shizhong, and others consulted, using provocative language, saying four groups of tribal people sent up memorials, all attributing blame to former officials; although the words mostly slander and embellish, the matter when it happened also had causes.
translations.idiomatic: He colluded with the Ministers of Rites and War, Fang Xianfu and Wang Shizhong, drafting inflammatory language alleging that four separate tribal petitions all blamed former officials—embellished though the accounts were, they claimed, the complaints had some basis.

sentences.zh: 宜遣官严核激变虚实，用服其心，其他具如前议。

translations.literal: Officials should be dispatched strictly to verify whether incitement caused the uprising was real or false, to win their hearts; other matters as previously deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: An official commission should rigorously investigate whether frontier officials had provoked the crisis, to win over the tribes; all other conditions should follow the prior recommendation.

sentences.zh: 九畴报捷时，言满速儿、牙兰已毙砲石下，二人实未死。

translations.literal: When Jiuchi reported the victory, he said Mansuer and Yalan had already died under cannon and stone bombardment; the two men in fact had not died.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Jiuchi reported his victory, he claimed that Mansuer and Yalan had been killed by artillery—but both men were still alive.

sentences.zh: 帝固疑之。

translations.literal: The emperor indeed was suspicious of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was already skeptical.

sentences.zh: 览萼等议，益疑边臣欺罔，手诏数百言，切责九畴，欲置之死，而戒首辅杨一清勿党庇，遂遣官逮九畴。

translations.literal: Reading the deliberations of E and others, he grew still more suspicious that frontier officials were deceiving him. He wrote a handwritten edict of several hundred words, sharply rebuking Jiuchi and intending to put him to death, yet admonishing Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing not to shield him as a factional ally, and then dispatched officials to arrest Jiuchi.
translations.idiomatic: After reading the recommendations of Gui E and his allies, the emperor grew convinced that frontier officials had lied to him. He drafted a handwritten edict of several hundred words fiercely condemning Jiuchi and calling for his execution, while warning Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing not to protect him. Officials were sent to arrest Jiuchi.

sentences.zh: 尚书金献民、侍郎李昆以下，坐累者四十余人。

translations.literal: Minister Jin Xianmin, Vice Minister Li Kun, and those below—more than forty people were implicated.
translations.idiomatic: More than forty officials were implicated, including Minister Jin Xianmin and Vice Minister Li Kun.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，九畴逮至下狱。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, Jiuchi was arrested and brought to prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, Jiuchi was arrested and thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 萼等必欲杀之，并株连廷和、泽。

translations.literal: E and others insisted on killing him, and also sought to implicate Tinghe and Ze.
translations.idiomatic: Gui E and his faction were determined to have him executed and sought to drag Yang Tinghe and Peng Ze into the case as well.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚书胡世宁力救，帝稍悟，免死戍边，泽、献民等皆落职。

translations.literal: Minister of Punishments Hu Shining forcefully intervened to save him. The emperor came somewhat to his senses, commuted the death sentence to exile on the frontier, and Ze, Xianmin, and the others were all dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Punishments Hu Shining fought hard to save him. The emperor partially relented, commuting the death sentence to frontier exile. Peng Ze, Jin Xianmin, and the others were all stripped of their posts.

sentences.zh: 番酋气益骄，而萼又荐王琼督三边，尽释还九畴所系番使，许之通贡。

translations.literal: The tribal chieftains grew all the more arrogant, and E again recommended Wang Qiong to supervise the Three Frontiers. All tribal envoys detained by Jiuchi were released and returned, and they were permitted to send tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal chieftains grew bolder still. Gui E then recommended Wang Qiong to oversee the Three Frontiers, ordered the release of all tribal envoys detained by Jiuchi, and permitted tribute missions to resume.

sentences.zh: 番酋迄不悔罪，侮玩如故。

translations.literal: The tribal chieftain never repented his crimes and continued to treat the court with the same contempt as before.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftain never repented and continued to treat the court with the same insolent contempt as before.

sentences.zh: 时以牙兰获罪其主，率部帐来归，边臣受之。

translations.literal: At that time, because Yalan had been condemned by his lord, he led his clan and followers to submit; frontier officials accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: About this time Yalan, having fallen out with his lord, led his clan and followers to defect. Frontier officials accepted them.

sentences.zh: 满速儿怒，其部下虎力纳咱儿引瓦剌二千余骑犯肃州，至老鹳堡，值撒马儿罕贡使在堡中，贼呼与语，游击彭浚急引兵击之。

translations.literal: Mansuer was enraged. His subordinate Huli Naz'aer led more than two thousand Oirat cavalry to invade Suzhou and reached Lao Guan Fort, where tribute envoys from Samarkand were in the fort. The bandits called out to speak with them. Mobile-detachment commander Peng Jun urgently led troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Mansuer was furious. His subordinate Huli Naz'aer led more than two thousand Oirat horsemen against Suzhou as far as Lao Guan Fort, where Samarkand tribute envoys happened to be lodged. The raiders shouted over to parley. Mobile-detachment commander Peng Jun rushed troops forward and attacked.

sentences.zh: 贼言欲问信通和，浚不听，进战，破之。

translations.literal: The bandits said they wished to inquire about communication and peace; Jun would not listen, advanced to fight, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders claimed they only wished to open talks for peace. Peng Jun refused to listen, pressed the attack, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 贼遁走赤斤，使人持番文求贡，委罪瓦剌，词多悖谩。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Chijin and sent someone bearing a tribal document requesting tribute, shifting blame onto the Oirats; the language was mostly rebellious and insulting.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders fled to Chijin and dispatched an envoy with a tribal petition requesting tribute, blaming the Oirats while using language that was mostly defiant and insulting.

sentences.zh: 琼希时贵指，必欲议抚，因言番人且悔，宜原情赦罪，以罢兵息民，并上浚及副使赵载功状。

translations.literal: Qiong, hoping to suit the wishes of the powerful at court, necessarily wished to discuss appeasement. He therefore said the tribal people were already repentant and their crimes should be forgiven in consideration of circumstances, so as to cease warfare and give the people rest, and also submitted accounts of Jun's and Vice Commissioner Zhao Zai's merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qiong, eager to align himself with the court's powerful faction, pressed for appeasement. He argued that the tribes were already repentant and should be pardoned so that fighting could cease and the people find relief, and he submitted reports on the achievements of Peng Jun and Vice Commissioner Zhao Zai.

sentences.zh: 章下兵部。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 初，胡世宁之救陈九畴也，欲弃哈密不守，言：“拜牙即久归土鲁番，即还故土，亦其臣属，其他族裔无可继者。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Hu Shining had come to Chen Jiuchi's rescue, he had wished to abandon Hami and not defend it, saying: "Baiyaji has long since returned to Turpan; even if he returned to his old territory, he would still be their subject. Among other clansmen there is no one who can succeed."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Hu Shining had intervened to save Chen Jiuchi, he had argued for abandoning Hami altogether: "Baiyaji has long since returned to Turpan. Even if he came back to his old territory, he would still be their subject, and among the other clans there is no one fit to succeed him."

sentences.zh: 回回一种，早已归之。

translations.literal: The Hui people as a single group long since submitted to them.
translations.idiomatic: The Hui people as a whole submitted to them long ago.

sentences.zh: 哈剌灰、畏兀儿二族逃附肃州已久，不可驱之出关。

translations.literal: The Karakhui and Uyghur two peoples have fled and attached themselves to Suzhou for a long time; they cannot be driven out beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Karakhui and Uyghur peoples have long since fled to Suzhou for refuge and cannot now be driven back beyond the pass.

sentences.zh: 然则哈密将安兴复哉？

translations.literal: In that case, by what means would Hami be restored?
translations.idiomatic: In that case, how could Hami ever be restored?

sentences.zh: 纵得忠顺嫡派，畀之金印，助之兵食，谁与为守？

translations.literal: Even if one obtained a legitimate direct descendant of the loyal-and-obedient lineage and gave him the gold seal, and aided him with troops and provisions, who would defend it with him?
translations.idiomatic: Even if a legitimate heir of the Prince of Loyalty and Obedience were found, given the gold seal, and supplied with troops and provisions—who would stand guard with him?

sentences.zh: 不过一二年，复为所夺，益彼富强，辱我皇命，徒使再得城印，为后日要挟之地。

translations.literal: In no more than a year or two it would again be seized by them, increasing their wealth and strength, disgracing our imperial commands, and merely allowing them once again to obtain the city and seal as a site from which to extort us on a later day.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year or two it would be seized again, making the enemy richer and stronger while disgracing imperial authority—and merely giving them the city and seal once more as leverage for future extortion.

sentences.zh: 乞圣明熟筹，如先朝和宁交址故事，置哈密勿问。

translations.literal: I beg the sage brilliance of the throne to consider this carefully, as in the precedent of earlier reigns toward Hening and Jiaozhi: set Hami aside and do not meddle.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to weigh this carefully and, following the precedent of earlier reigns with Hening and Jiaozhi, leave Hami alone.

sentences.zh: 如其不侵扰，则许之通贡。

translations.literal: If they do not invade or harass, then permit them to send tribute.
translations.idiomatic: If they refrain from raiding, permit tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 否则，闭关绝之，庶不以外番疲中国。”

translations.literal: Otherwise, close the passes and cut them off, so that in the end the outer tribes do not wear out China.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, close the passes and cut them off, so that outer tribes do not drain the empire's strength.

sentences.zh: 詹事霍韬力驳其非。

translations.literal: Junior Mentor Huo Tao forcefully rebutted this as wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Mentor Huo Tao forcefully rejected this argument.

sentences.zh: 至是，世宁改掌兵部，上言：“番酋变诈多端，欲取我肃州，则渐置奸回于内地。

translations.literal: At this time Shining had transferred to head the Ministry of War and memorialized: "The tribal chieftain is changeable and deceitful in many ways. When he wishes to take our Suzhou, he gradually installs treacherous Hui inside the interior."
translations.idiomatic: By this time Shining had moved to head the Ministry of War and memorialized: "The tribal chieftain is endlessly treacherous. When he aims at Suzhou, he gradually plants disloyal Hui agents inside the frontier."

sentences.zh: 事觉，则多纵反间，倾我辅臣。

translations.literal: When the matter is discovered, he frequently deploys counter-espionage to topple our chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When exposed, he spreads counter-intelligence to bring down our chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 乃者许之朝贡，使方入关，而贼兵已至，河西几危。

translations.literal: Recently tribute was permitted; the envoys had just entered the pass when bandit troops already arrived, and Hexi nearly fell into peril.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, tribute was permitted—but the envoys had barely entered the pass when raiders arrived, and Hexi nearly fell.

sentences.zh: 此闭关与通贡，利害较然。

translations.literal: The benefit and harm of closing the passes versus permitting tribute are quite clear by comparison.
translations.idiomatic: The contrast between closing the passes and permitting tribute could not be clearer.

sentences.zh: 今琼等既言贼薄我城堡，缚我士卒，声言大举，以恐吓天朝，而又言贼方惧悔，宜仍许通贡，何自相牴牾。

translations.literal: Now Qiong and others have already said the bandits pressed upon our fortresses, bound our soldiers, and proclaimed a major campaign to intimidate the Celestial Dynasty, yet they also say the bandits are now fearful and repentant and tribute should still be permitted—how they contradict themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qiong and his allies report that the raiders pressed our fortresses, bound our soldiers, and threatened a major invasion to intimidate the court—yet they also claim the enemy is now fearful and repentant and that tribute should resume. How can these accounts be reconciled?

sentences.zh: 霍韬又以贼无印信番文为疑，臣谓即有印信，亦安足据。

translations.literal: Huo Tao also doubts them because the bandits had no sealed tribal document; I say even if there were a seal and document, it would not suffice as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Tao also doubts them because the petition bore no official tribal seal. I say that even with a seal, it would prove nothing.

sentences.zh: 第毋堕其术中，以间我忠臣，弛我边备，斯可矣。

translations.literal: Simply do not fall into their stratagem to set apart our loyal ministers and relax our frontier defenses—that is enough.
translations.idiomatic: We need only avoid falling into their trap—turning loyal ministers against one another and relaxing frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 牙兰本我属番，为彼掠去，今束身来归，事属反正，宜即抚而用之。

translations.literal: Yalan was originally our subject tribesman, carried off by them; now he has bound himself and come to submit—this is a matter of returning to the right. He should at once be conciliated and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Yalan was originally our subject tribesman before being carried off by the enemy. Now he has come of his own accord—a legitimate return to allegiance. He should be conciliated and put to use at once.

sentences.zh: 招彼携贰，益我籓篱。

translations.literal: Summon those who waver in allegiance to them and augment our frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Win over those who waver in their loyalty and strengthen our frontier bulwark.

sentences.zh: 至于兴复哈密，臣等窃以为非中国所急也。

translations.literal: As for restoring Hami, we privately consider that it is not what China urgently needs.
translations.idiomatic: As for restoring Hami, we privately believe it is not an urgent priority for the empire.

sentences.zh: 夫哈密三立三绝，今其王已为贼用，民尽流亡。

translations.literal: Hami has been established three times and cut off three times; now its king already serves the bandits, and the people have all become refugees.
translations.idiomatic: Hami has been established and lost three times over. Its king now serves the enemy, and the people have all fled.

sentences.zh: 借使更立他种，彼强则入寇，弱则从贼，难保为不侵不叛之臣。

translations.literal: Even if another tribe were set up in his place, when they are strong they invade, when weak they follow the bandits—one cannot guarantee they would be subjects who neither invade nor rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Even if another tribe were installed, when strong they would raid, when weak they would follow the enemy—there is no guarantee of loyal, non-aggressive subjects.

sentences.zh: 故臣以为立之无益，适令番酋挟为奸利耳。

translations.literal: Therefore I consider that establishing a ruler there is without benefit and merely lets the tribal chieftain use it to extort illicit profit.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing a ruler there, I believe, would serve no purpose except to give the chieftain another lever for extortion.

sentences.zh: 乞赐琼玺书，令会同甘肃守臣，遣番使归谕满速儿，诘以入寇状。

translations.literal: I beg that an imperial missive under seal be granted to Qiong, ordering him jointly with Gansu defense officials to send the tribal envoy back to instruct Mansuer and interrogate him concerning the circumstances of the invasion.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that an imperial missive under seal be sent to Wang Qiong, ordering him to work with Gansu defense officials to send the tribal envoy back and demand that Mansuer account for the raids.

sentences.zh: 倘委为不知，则令械送虎力纳咱儿。

translations.literal: If he disclaims knowledge, then order him to send Huli Naz'aer in fetters.
translations.idiomatic: If he pleads ignorance, order him to deliver Huli Naz'aer in chains.

sentences.zh: 或事出瓦剌，则缚其人以自赎。

translations.literal: Or if the affair originated with the Oirats, then bind those persons to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: If the Oirats were responsible, he should deliver the culprits to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 否则羁其使臣，发兵往讨，庶威信并行，贼知敛戢。

translations.literal: Otherwise detain their envoys and dispatch troops to punish them—then authority and good faith will proceed together and the bandits will know to restrain themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, detain their envoys and send troops to punish them—so that authority and credibility go hand in hand and the raiders learn restraint.

sentences.zh: 更敕琼为国忠谋，力求善后之策，以通番纳贡为权宜，足食固圉为久计，封疆幸甚。”

translations.literal: Further instruct Qiong to plan for the state's loyalty, strive to find policies for what comes after, take permitting tribal tribute as a temporary measure and securing ample food and solid defenses as the long-term plan—the frontier will be greatly fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: Further instruct Wang Qiong to serve the state's interests faithfully, devise a sound long-term policy, treat tribal tribute as a temporary expedient, and make securing provisions and fortifying defenses the enduring strategy—the frontier will be greatly strengthened.

sentences.zh: 疏入，帝深然之，命琼熟计详处，毋轻信番言。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, the emperor deeply approved it and ordered Qiong to consider carefully and handle the matter in detail, and not lightly trust tribal words.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor strongly approved it and ordered Wang Qiong to deliberate carefully and handle the matter thoroughly, and not to trust tribal assurances lightly.

sentences.zh: 至明年，甘肃巡抚唐泽亦以哈密未易兴复，请专图自治之策。

translations.literal: By the following year, Gansu Grand Coordinator Tang Ze also, because Hami was not easily restored, requested focusing solely on a policy of self-governance.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Gansu Grand Coordinator Tang Ze also argued that Hami could not easily be restored and urged a policy focused on strengthening local defenses.

sentences.zh: 琼善之，据以上闻，帝报可。

translations.literal: Qiong thought well of it, reported it upward based on this, and the emperor replied that it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qiong approved and forwarded the proposal; the emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 自是置哈密不问，土鲁番许之通贡，西陲藉以息肩。

translations.literal: From this Hami was set aside without inquiry; Turpan was permitted to send tribute, and the western frontier thereby gained relief from its burden.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Hami was left alone. Turpan was permitted to send tribute, and the western frontier gained a measure of relief.

sentences.zh: 而哈密后为失拜烟答子米儿马黑木所有，服属土鲁番。

translations.literal: Later Hami came to be held by Shibaiyanda's son Mi'ermahaimu, subordinate to Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: Hami later fell to Shibaiyanda's son Mi'ermahaimu, who acknowledged Turpan's authority.

sentences.zh: 朝廷犹令其比岁一贡，异于诸番，迄隆庆、万历朝犹入贡不绝，然非忠顺王苗裔矣。

translations.literal: The court still ordered them to send tribute once per year, different from other tribes; through the Longqing and Wanli reigns tribute continued without interruption, yet they were no longer descendants of the Prince of Loyalty and Obedience.
translations.idiomatic: The court still required annual tribute—a privilege distinct from other tribes—and missions continued through the Longqing and Wanli reigns, though the rulers were no longer descendants of the Prince of Loyalty and Obedience.

sentences.zh: 柳城，一名鲁陈，又名柳陈城，即后汉柳中地，西域长史所治。

translations.literal: Liucheng, also called Luchen, also called Liuchen city, is the Liuzhong territory of Later Han, where the Chief Commandant of the Western Regions was stationed.
translations.idiomatic: Liucheng—also called Luchen or Liuchen city—occupies the Liuzhong region of Later Han, where the Chief Commandant of the Western Regions had his seat.

sentences.zh: 唐置柳中县。

translations.literal: Under the Tang it was made Liuzhong county.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was established as Liuzhong county.

sentences.zh: 西去火州七十里，东去哈密千里。

translations.literal: Seventy li west of Huozhou, one thousand li east of Hami.
translations.idiomatic: It lies seventy li west of Huozhou and a thousand li east of Hami.

sentences.zh: 经一大川，道旁多骸骨，相传有鬼魅，行旅早暮失侣多迷死。

translations.literal: Passing through a great river valley, by the roadside are many skeletons; it is said there are ghosts and monsters, and travelers who lose their companions at dawn or dusk often wander to their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers pass through a great river valley where skeletons line the road. Ghosts and demons are said to haunt the place, and wayfarers who lose their companions at dawn or dusk often wander to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 出大川，渡流沙，在火山下，有城屹然广二三里，即柳城也。

translations.literal: Leaving the great valley and crossing drifting sands, below the Volcano there is a city standing tall, two or three li across—it is Liucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the great valley, after crossing drifting sands at the foot of the Volcano, a city rises two or three li across—Liucheng itself.

sentences.zh: 四面皆田园，流水环绕，树木阴翳。

translations.literal: On all four sides are fields and gardens; flowing streams encircle them, and trees cast dense shade.
translations.idiomatic: Fields and gardens surround it on every side; streams wind through the land and trees cast deep shade.

sentences.zh: 土宜穄麦豆麻，有桃李枣瓜胡芦之属。

translations.literal: The soil is suited to millet, wheat, beans, and hemp; there are peach, plum, jujube, melon, and gourd varieties.
translations.idiomatic: The soil supports millet, wheat, beans, and hemp, along with peaches, plums, jujubes, melons, gourds, and the like.

sentences.zh: 而葡萄最多，小而甘，无核，名锁子葡萄。

translations.literal: Grapes are the most abundant—small, sweet, and seedless, called lock-grape.
translations.idiomatic: Grapes are especially abundant—small, sweet, and seedless, known as lock-grapes.

sentences.zh: 畜有牛羊马驼。

translations.literal: Livestock include cattle, sheep, horses, and camels.
translations.idiomatic: Livestock include cattle, sheep, horses, and camels.

sentences.zh: 节候常和。

translations.literal: The seasons are usually mild.
translations.idiomatic: The climate is generally mild.

sentences.zh: 土人纯朴，男子椎结，妇人蒙皁布，其语音类畏兀儿。

translations.literal: The native people are simple and honest; men wear topknots, women cover themselves with black cloth, and their speech resembles Uyghur.
translations.idiomatic: The people are plain and honest. Men wear topknots; women veil themselves in black cloth. Their speech resembles Uyghur.

sentences.zh: 永乐四年，刘帖木儿使别失八里，因命赍彩币赐柳城酋长。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle, Liu Timuer was sent on mission to Beshbalik and was ordered to carry colored silks to bestow on the Liucheng chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 4, Liu Timuer was dispatched to Beshbalik and ordered to carry colored silks as gifts for the Liucheng chieftain.

sentences.zh: 明年，其万户瓦赤剌即遣使来贡。

translations.literal: The next year its commander-in-chief of ten thousand households Wachila immediately dispatched envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The following year its commander of ten thousand households, Wachila, sent envoys to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年，傅安自西域还，其酋复遣使随入贡。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when Fu An returned from the Western Regions, the chieftain again dispatched envoys to accompany him in presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when Fu An returned from the Western Regions, the chieftain again sent envoys to accompany him in presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝即命安赍绮帛报之。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered An to carry brocades and silks in return.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Fu An to carry brocades and silks in return.

sentences.zh: 十一年夏，遣使随白阿儿忻台入贡。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eleventh year, envoys were dispatched to accompany Bai A'erxintai in presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eleventh year, envoys accompanied Bai A'erxintai in presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬，万户观音奴再遣使随安入贡。

translations.literal: In winter, the commander-in-chief of ten thousand households Guanyinnu again dispatched envoys to accompany An in presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, commander Guanyinnu again sent envoys to accompany Fu An in presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十年与哈密共贡羊二千。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year they jointly presented two thousand sheep with Hami.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year they jointly presented two thousand sheep with Hami.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，头目阿黑把失来贡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande, the headman Aheibashi came to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 5 the headman Aheibashi came to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 正統五年、十三年並入貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth and thirteenth years of Zhengtong they again came to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 5 and 13 they again presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 自後不復至。

translations.literal: After that they did not come again.
translations.idiomatic: After that they came no more.

sentences.zh: 柳城密尔火州、土鲁番，凡天朝遣使及其酋长入贡，多与之偕。

translations.literal: Liucheng is adjacent to Huozhou and Turpan; whenever the Celestial Dynasty dispatched envoys and their chieftains came to present tribute, they often accompanied them together.
translations.idiomatic: Liucheng lies close to Huozhou and Turpan. Whenever the court dispatched envoys or its chieftains came to present tribute, they usually traveled together.

sentences.zh: 后土鲁番强，二国并为所灭。

translations.literal: Later Turpan grew strong and both states were destroyed and absorbed by it.
translations.idiomatic: Later Turpan grew powerful and absorbed both states.

sentences.zh: 火州，又名哈剌，在柳城西七十里，土鲁番东三十里，即汉车师前王地。

translations.literal: Huozhou, also called Hala, is seventy li west of Liucheng and thirty li east of Turpan—the territory of the Former King of the Cheshi Front Kingdom under Han.
translations.idiomatic: Huozhou—also called Hala—lies seventy li west of Liucheng and thirty li east of Turpan, on the territory of the Han-era Front Kingdom of Cheshi.

sentences.zh: 隋时为高昌国。

translations.literal: Under the Sui it was the Gaochang kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui it was the kingdom of Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 唐太宗灭高昌，以其地为西州。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong of Tang destroyed Gaochang and made its territory Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong of Tang destroyed Gaochang and made its territory the prefecture of Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 宋时回鹘居之，尝入贡。

translations.literal: Under the Song the Uyghurs dwelt there and sometimes sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song the Uyghurs lived there and sometimes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 元名火州，与安定、曲先诸卫统号畏兀儿，置达鲁花赤监治之。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it was named Huozhou; together with the guards Anding, Quxian, and others it was collectively styled Uyghur, with a darughachi stationed to supervise it.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was named Huozhou. Together with the guards of Anding, Quxian, and others it was collectively known as Uyghur, with a darughachi stationed to govern it.

sentences.zh: 永乐四年五月命鸿胪丞刘帖木儿护别失八里使者归，因赍彩币赐其王子哈散。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Yongle the emperor ordered Honglu Assistant Liu Timuer to escort the Beshbalik envoys home and, in the process, carry colored silks to bestow on the prince Hasan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongle 4 the emperor ordered Honglu Assistant Liu Timuer to escort the Beshbalik envoys home and, en route, carry colored silks as gifts for Prince Hasan.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使贡玉璞方物。

translations.literal: The next year envoys were dispatched to present jade rough and local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The following year envoys presented jade rough and local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 使臣言，回回行贾京师者，甘、凉军士多私送出境，泄漏边务。

translations.literal: The envoy stated that Muslim merchants traveling to the capital from Gan and Liang were often privately escorted beyond the border by garrison soldiers, leaking frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy reported that garrison soldiers in Ganzhou and Liangzhou often smuggled Muslim merchants bound for the capital across the border, leaking frontier intelligence.

sentences.zh: 帝命御史往按，且敕总兵官宋晟严束之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered censors to go investigate, and also commanded the regional commander Song Sheng to restrain them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered censors to investigate and commanded regional commander Song Sheng to enforce strict discipline.

sentences.zh: 七年遣使偕哈烈、撒马儿罕来贡。

translations.literal: In the seventh year envoys were dispatched to present tribute together with Herat and Samarkand.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year envoys came to present tribute together with Herat and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 十一年夏，都指挥白阿儿忻台遣使偕俺的千、失剌思等九国来贡。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eleventh year Regional Commander Bai A'erxintai dispatched envoys together with Andigan, Shiraz, and nine other states to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eleventh year Regional Commander Bai A'erxintai dispatched envoys from Andigan, Shiraz, and eight other states to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋，命陈诚、李暹等以玺书、文绮、纱罗、布帛往劳。

translations.literal: In autumn Chen Cheng and Li Xian and others were ordered to go with imperial missives, patterned silks, gauze, silk, and cloth to extend imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Chen Cheng, Li Xian, and others were dispatched with imperial missives, patterned silks, gauze, silk, and cloth to convey the court's favor.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，遣使随诚来贡。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year envoys were dispatched to accompany Cheng in presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirteenth year envoys accompanied Chen Cheng in presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 自是久不至。

translations.literal: From this they did not come for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: After that they did not come for a long time.

sentences.zh: 正统十三年复贡，后遂绝。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhengtong they again presented tribute; afterward it ceased entirely.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 13 they presented tribute again; afterward missions ceased entirely.

sentences.zh: 其地多山，青红若火，故名火州。

translations.literal: The land is mostly mountainous; blue and red like fire, hence the name Huozhou (Fire Prefecture).
translations.idiomatic: The land is mostly mountainous, its blue and red hues like fire—hence the name Fire Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 气候热。

translations.literal: The climate is hot.
translations.idiomatic: The climate is hot.

sentences.zh: 五谷、畜产与柳城同。

translations.literal: The five grains and livestock are the same as Liucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Its grains and livestock are the same as Liucheng's.

sentences.zh: 城方十余里，僧寺多于民居。

translations.literal: The city is more than ten li square; Buddhist temples outnumber dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: The city covers more than ten li square; Buddhist temples outnumber dwellings.

sentences.zh: 东有荒城，即高昌国都，汉戊己校尉所治。

translations.literal: To the east is a ruined city, the capital of the Gaochang kingdom, where the Han Wuji Colonel was stationed.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lies a ruined city—the former capital of Gaochang, where the Han Wuji Colonel had his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 西北连别失八里。

translations.literal: To the northwest it connects with Beshbalik.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest it borders Beshbalik.

sentences.zh: 国小，不能自立，后为土鲁番所并。

translations.literal: The state was small and could not stand on its own; later it was annexed by Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: The state was small and could not stand alone; later Turpan annexed it.

sentences.zh: 土鲁番

translations.literal: Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan.

sentences.zh: 土鲁番，在火州西百里，去哈密千余里，嘉峪关二千六百里。

translations.literal: Turpan is one hundred li west of Huozhou, more than one thousand li from Hami and twenty-six hundred li from Jiayu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan lies a hundred li west of Huozhou, more than a thousand li from Hami and twenty-six hundred li from Jiayu Pass.

sentences.zh: 汉车师前王地。

translations.literal: The territory of the Former King of the Cheshi Front Kingdom under Han.
translations.idiomatic: It occupies the Han-era territory of the Front Kingdom of Cheshi.

sentences.zh: 隋高昌国。

translations.literal: Under the Sui, the Gaochang kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui it was the kingdom of Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 唐灭高昌，置西州及交河县，此则交河县安乐城也。

translations.literal: When the Tang destroyed Gaochang they established Xizhou and Jiaohe county; this place is the Anle city of Jiaohe county.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tang destroyed Gaochang they established Xizhou and Jiaohe county; this is Anle city in Jiaohe county.

sentences.zh: 宋复名高昌，为回鹘所据，尝入贡。

translations.literal: Under the Song the name Gaochang was restored; it was occupied by the Uyghurs and sometimes sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song the name Gaochang was restored. The Uyghurs held it and sometimes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 元设万户府。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan a wanhu prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan a myriarch administration was established there.

sentences.zh: 永乐四年遣官使别失八里，道其地，以彩币赐之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle envoys were dispatched to Beshbalik, passing through this territory and bestowing colored silks upon it.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 4 (1406), the court sent envoys to Beshbalik; traveling through Turpan, they bestowed silk gifts upon the local ruler.

sentences.zh: 其万户赛因帖木儿遣使贡玉璞，明年达京师。

translations.literal: Its wanhu Sayin Timur sent envoys presenting raw jade; they reached the capital the following year.
translations.idiomatic: The wanhu Sayin Timur sent envoys with offerings of uncut jade, which reached the capital the following year.

sentences.zh: 六年，其国番僧清来率徒法泉等朝贡。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the foreign monk Qinglai of that country led his disciples Faquan and others to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Buddhist monk Qinglai of Turpan led disciples including Faquan to the capital to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 天子欲令化导番俗，即授为灌顶慈慧圆智普通国师，徒七人并为土鲁番僧纲司官，赐赉甚厚。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven wished to civilize and guide barbarian customs; he forthwith invested Qinglai as Abhiseka Compassionate Wisdom Perfect Knowledge Universal State Preceptor, appointed all seven disciples as officers of the Turpan monastic registry, and granted lavish rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, wishing to transform local customs through Buddhism, invested Qinglai as State Preceptor of Abhiseka, Compassionate Wisdom, Perfect Knowledge, and Universal Teaching, appointed all seven disciples to the Turpan monastic registry, and lavished gifts upon them.

sentences.zh: 由是其徒来者不绝，贡名马、海青及他物。

translations.literal: Henceforth his disciples came unceasingly, presenting famous horses, gyrfalcons, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter his disciples kept arriving, offering fine horses, gyrfalcons, and other tribute.

sentences.zh: 天子亦数遣官奖劳之。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven also repeatedly sent officials to encourage and reward them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in turn repeatedly sent officials to commend and reward them.

sentences.zh: 二十年，其酋尹吉儿察与哈密共贡马千三百匹，赐赉有加。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, its chieftain Yinji'ercha together with Hami jointly presented thirteen hundred horses; rewards were increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the chieftain Yinji'ercha and Hami together presented thirteen hundred horses; the court increased its gifts in return.

sentences.zh: 已而尹吉儿察为别失八里酋歪思所逐，走归京师。

translations.literal: Before long Yinji'ercha was driven out by Wasi, chieftain of Beshbalik, and fled back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yinji'ercha was expelled by Wasi, chieftain of Beshbalik, and fled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 天子悯之，命为都督佥事，遣还故土。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven took pity on him, appointed him assistant regional commander, and sent him back to his homeland.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took pity on him, made him assistant regional commander, and sent him back to his homeland.

sentences.zh: 尹吉儿察德中国，洪熙元年躬率部落来朝。

translations.literal: Yinji'ercha recognized China's virtue; in the first year of Hongxi he personally led his tribe to court.
translations.idiomatic: Yinji'ercha came to esteem the Ming court; in Hongxi 1 (1425) he led his people to the capital in person.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年亦如之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande he did likewise.
translations.idiomatic: He did the same again in Xuande 1 (1426).

sentences.zh: 天子待之甚厚，还国病卒。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven treated him with great favor; after returning to his country he fell ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor treated him with great generosity; he returned home and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 三年，其子满哥帖木儿来朝。

translations.literal: In the third year his son Manggetiemuer came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later his son Manggetiemuer came to court.

sentences.zh: 已而都督锁恪弟猛哥帖木儿来朝，命为指挥佥事。五年，都指挥佥事也先帖木儿来朝。正统六年，朝议土鲁番久失贡，因米昔儿使臣还，令赍钞币赐其酋巴剌麻儿。

translations.literal: Later Mengge Temür, younger brother of the Commander Suoke, came to court and was appointed Assistant Regional Commander. In the fifth year, Assistant Regional Commander Yesen Temür came to court. In the sixth year of Zhengtong, the court discussed Turpan's long failure to send tribute; taking advantage of the return of Mamluk envoys, it ordered them to carry paper money and silks to bestow upon its chieftain Balama'er.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Mengge Temür, younger brother of Commander Suoke, came to court and was appointed Assistant Regional Commander. In the fifth year, Assistant Regional Commander Yesen Temür came to court. In Zhengtong 6 (1441), noting that Turpan had long ceased tribute, the court sent gifts of paper money and silks with returning Mamluk envoys to the chieftain Balama'er.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使入贡。

translations.literal: The next year envoys were sent to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Turpan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 初，其地介于阗、别失八里诸大国间，势甚微弱。

translations.literal: At first its territory lay between Khotan, Beshbalik, and other great states; its strength was very weak.
translations.idiomatic: At first Turpan lay wedged between Khotan, Beshbalik, and other powerful states, and was very weak.

sentences.zh: 后侵掠火州、柳城，皆为所并，国日强，其酋也密力火者遂僭称王。

translations.literal: Later it raided Huozhou and Liucheng, annexing them all; the state grew daily stronger, and its chieftain Yamilihuozhe presumptuously styled himself king.
translations.idiomatic: Later it invaded Huozhou and Liucheng and annexed them both; growing ever stronger, its chieftain Yamilihuozhe took to calling himself king.

sentences.zh: 以景泰三年，偕其妻及部下头目各遣使入贡。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingtai, he together with his wife and subordinate chieftains each dispatched envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 3 (1452), he, his wife, and subordinate chieftains each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 天顺三年复贡，其使臣进秩者二十有四人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianshun tribute was presented again; twenty-four of its envoys received promotions in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 3 (1459) tribute came again; twenty-four of the envoys were promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 先後命指揮白全、都指揮桑斌等使其國。

translations.literal: Successively the commander Bai Quan, regional commander Sang Bin, and others were ordered as envoys to their country.
translations.idiomatic: The court successively dispatched the commander Bai Quan and the regional commander Sang Bin as envoys to Turpan.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，礼官姚夔等定议，土鲁番三年或五年一贡，贡不得过十人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua, ritual officials led by Yao Kui fixed the regulation: Turpan should present tribute once every three or five years, with no more than ten persons in each mission.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 1 (1465), the Ministry of Rites under Yao Kui set rules limiting Turpan to tribute once every three or five years, with no more than ten envoys per mission.

sentences.zh: 五年遣使来贡，其酋阿力自称速檀，奏求海青、鞍马、蟒服、彩币、器用。

translations.literal: In the fifth year envoys were sent to present tribute; its chieftain Ali styled himself sultan and memorialized requesting gyrfalcons, saddled horses, python robes, colored silks, and utensils.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year envoys arrived; the chieftain Ali styled himself sultan and petitioned for gyrfalcons, saddled horses, python-pattern robes, silks, and furnishings.

sentences.zh: 礼官言物多违禁，不可尽从，命赐彩币、布帛。

translations.literal: Ritual officials said many of the items were forbidden and could not all be granted; they were ordered to be given colored silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites noted that many items violated regulations and could not all be granted; the court ordered colored silks and cloth given instead.

sentences.zh: 明年复贡，奏求忽拨思筝、鼓罗、䩞镫、高丽布诸物。

translations.literal: The next year tribute was presented again; they memorialized requesting khobus zithers, golos drums, zhan lamps, Goryeo cloth, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they sent tribute again, requesting Persian zithers, drums, lamps, Goryeo cloth, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 廷议不许。

translations.literal: The court deliberated and did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused.

sentences.zh: 时土鲁番愈强，而哈密以无主削弱，阿力欲并之。

translations.literal: At this time Turpan grew ever stronger, while Hami, lacking a ruler, grew weak; Ali wished to annex it.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan was growing stronger; Hami, left without a ruler, was weakening; Ali sought to annex it.

sentences.zh: 九年春，袭破其城，执王母，夺金印，分兵守之而去。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year he launched a surprise attack and took the city, seizing the queen mother, seizing the gold seal, leaving troops to garrison it, and departing.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year he stormed Hami, captured the queen mother, seized the gold seal, posted troops to hold the city, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 朝廷命李文等经略，无功而还。

translations.literal: The court ordered Li Wen and others to conduct military operations; they achieved nothing and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched Li Wen and others to reclaim the territory, but they achieved nothing and returned.

sentences.zh: 阿力修贡如故，一岁中，使来者三，朝廷仍善待之，未尝一语严诘。

translations.literal: Ali continued tribute as before; within one year envoys came three times; the court still treated them kindly and never once sternly rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: Ali continued sending tribute as before—three missions in a single year—yet the court still treated them graciously and never uttered a word of stern reproach.

sentences.zh: 贡使益傲，求驯象。

translations.literal: The tribute envoys grew ever more arrogant and requested trained elephants.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys grew bolder and asked for trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 兵部言象以备仪卫，礼有进献，无求索，乃却其请。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said elephants are for ceremonial guard; ritual allows presentation but not demanding; the request was refused.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied that elephants were reserved for ceremonial guard—that tribute might be offered but not demanded—and refused the request.

sentences.zh: 使臣复言已得哈密城池及瓦剌奄檀王人马一万，又收捕曲先并亦思渴头目倒刺火只，乞朝廷遣使通道，往来和好。

translations.literal: The envoys further reported they had already taken Hami's city and ten thousand men and horses of the Oirat Yantan king, and also captured Quxian and Yisike chieftain Daocihuozhi; they begged the court to send envoys to open the route and establish mutual goodwill.
